jobs.title: Program Manager, Leave of Absence and Time Off
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

The Program Manager/Manager, Leave of Absence and Time Off is responsible for the end-to-end administration of employee leaves and time off programs, serving as a subject matter expert in leave of absence (LOA) and time off policies. This role partners closely with Veolia’s third-party leave administration vendor, HR Business Partners, HRIS, Benefits, Payroll, and Employee Health and Safety to ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations while delivering a high-quality employee and manager experience.

The role provides advanced-level support for Family and Medical Leave (FMLA), personal leave, military leave, state and local leaves, ADA accommodations, Veolia Caregiver leave, and paid time off programs. The Leave of Absence Administrator also plays a key role in policy governance, SOP development, audits, HRIS updates, and process improvement initiatives, including participation in M&A and global HRIS projects.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

Leave of Absence Administration

• Manage the full leave administration lifecycle, from an employee’s initial notice of need for leave through return-to-work.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for all leave of absence requests via phone, email, HR cases, and service tickets.
• Partner with the HR Shared Services team to direct administrative tasks to include operation design, training and resource creation.
• Coordinate and administer Family and Medical Leave, personal leave, unpaid leave, military leave, state and local leaves, ADA accommodations, and Veolia Paid Parental and Caregiver leave in partnership with the third-party leave administrator and Benefits COE.
• Communicate regularly with external leave vendors and Benefits COE regarding leave status, earnings for disability calculations, status changes, discrepancies, and issue resolution.
• Coordinate intermittent and reduced-schedule leave usage with managers and HR Business Partners and/or Employee Health and Safety, including assisting in identifying opportunities for ADA or other accommodations.
• Coordinate the use of paid leave (PTO, mandated paid leave, or other paid programs) with employees and managers. Collaborate with the Benefits COE on policy redesign, best practices and support design.
• Partner with Employee Health and Safety teams to ensure Workers’ Compensation status and pay information are accurate and current.
• Partner with Labor Relations to union specific leave of absence matters, escalations and/or collective bargaining agreement (CBA) implementations.
• Partner with Benefits COE on matters requiring policy interpretation, poor vendor performance and escalated situations to timely resolve matters or implement process improvements.Partner with the Payroll Department to ensure accurate federal and state filing deductions, audits and resolve employee queries and escalated matters.
• Coordinate and maintain the recovery of missed benefit premiums or deductions with Payroll, third party administrator and employee.
• Coordinate all necessary HRIS and external vendor system programming to ensure the integrity of existing and new programs in partnership with HRIS, Benefits COE, Payroll, and third-party vendors.
• Conduct and lead assessment of new and existing federal, state or local leave regulations to provide impact analysis, operation support design, implementation,communication and training, in partnership with Legal and the Benefits COE.
• Participate in quarterly business reviews to assess vendor performance and provide feedback.
• Coordinate, maintain and submit any required federal or state filing, applications and reporting in partnership with Payroll and Benefits COE.

Time Off Policy and Program Management

• Review, interpret, and support implementation and audit of new and updated time off policies. Partner with Benefits COE, legal, payroll, labor relations and other stakeholders to coordinate operational implementation and HR/employee education.
• Create, maintain, and update standard operating procedures (SOPs), process maps, and employee-facing knowledge resources for all paid time off programs, including:Flexible Time Off (FTO)VacationVolunteer Time OffPaid Safe and Sick Leave
• Provide Tier 2 support and resolve for time off and absence-related inquiries, escalating complex issues as needed.

HRIS, Data Integrity, and Compliance

• Maintain HR data integrity by accurately entering and updating employee information in HR systems.
• Partner with the HRIS team and leave administration vendors to ensure time off plans, leave requirements, and policy changes are properly configured, tested, and integrated within Workday.
• Participate in global HRIS initiatives, including M&A onboarding, system harmonization, and policy alignment.
• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local leave laws, as well as Veolia policies.
• Lead time off and leave audits to ensure compliance, accurate pay, and proper documentation.
• Ensure compliance with data privacy, audit, and governance standards across all jurisdictions.
• Preserve strict confidentiality of employee medical documentation and files.

Process Improvement and Stakeholder Partnership

• Identify and implement process improvements to optimize leave and time off workflows and enhance the employee experience.
• Develop and deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions for HR Shared Services, HR Business Partners, and Payroll.
• Participate in department-wide initiatives, projects, and M&A activities, providing subject matter expertise and operational insight.
• Build and maintain strong working relationships with Benefits, HRIS, Payroll, Employee Health and Safety, HR Business Partners, managers, and employees.
• Assist with employee engagement initiatives, reporting, and compliance audits as needed.
• Support ongoing HR, Manager and/or employee education on leave of absence processes and programs to improve experience and raise awareness.

Work Environment:

• Work Office environment.
• Hybrid role.

Education/Experience/Background:

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources or related field (or equivalent years of experience).
• Minimum of eight (8) years of progressive experience in leave of absence administration or management in a high volume, complex, multi unionwork environment.
• Broad HR knowledge of FMLA regulations, ADA, and other federal/state regulations in a multi-state environment.
• Strong working knowledge of federal, state, and local leave of absence laws and regulations.
• Experience administering complex leave and time off programs in a large or multi-jurisdictional organization.
• Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with third-party administrators and cross-functional HR teams.
• Experience working with HRIS systems; Workday experience strongly preferred.

Preferred

• Experience supporting M&A activities, labor unions, system harmonization, or global HR initiatives.
• Background in HR Shared Services or centralized HR operations.
• Experience with audits, compliance reviews, and process documentation.
• Experience with Workday.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and confidentiality.
• Excellent customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Subject matter expertise in leave of absence and time off administration.
• Regulatory and compliance focus.
• Process improvement mindset.
• Strong stakeholder partnership and collaboration.
• Customer-centric approach.
• Discretion and professionalism.

Benefits: Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!



As Sales Operations, you support commercial management with insights through dashboards, analysis, and forecasting. In addition, you serve as the central hub for information sharing and cross-functional alignment across the broader organisation, including Marketing, Finance, and Operations/Production.

You also enable the Sales team to operate as effectively as possible by supporting their day-to-day activities, improving processes, and ensuring they have the tools, data, and resources they need to succeed.



What you'll be doing

 - Owning and developing all reports and dashboards for the internal (management & sales team) and external (board & investor) audiences.

 - Support Commercial Management with their weekly forecasting meetings, analysis and goal settings etc.

 - Engage weekly with the production team to ensure production priorities and sales commitments are aligned.

 - Work closely with multiple departments including Marketing, Finance, Shipping, Production and Operations on behalf of the sales team.

 - Take ownership of our CRM system (HubSpot) and manage or maintain this environment, utilising external resources if necessary. Automate as many tasks as possible and ensure the system evolves to meet our changing needs.
   
   

Your Profile

 - 5+ years of experience in a busy Office and/or Sales environment

 - Familiarity with CRM systems and ability to use Excel well

 - Ideally coming from a fast-moving, hi-tech company

 - Experience and comfortable handling multiple priorities in a busy, dynamic environment
   
   

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. If this role excites you and you believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you!

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know this helps us with better decisions, more innovation, and strengthens our culture. In particular, we’d love to see more women in the quantum industry!

Are you interested in becoming an experienced Overhead Crane Service Technician? Join Konecranes, one of the world’s largest material handling companies. We're seeking skilled individuals with electrical and mechanical expertise, comfortable working at extreme heights. Our service technicians, the heart of our industry, thrive in a safety-first environment. You'll troubleshoot 480 3-phase motors, address crane issues, and collaborate with clients and facility directors to meet service needs across the United States.

Principal Responsibilities:

• Conduct inspections, maintenance, and repairs on electric overhead traveling cranes and hoists at customer locations.
• Provide on-call service as part of a rotation, including after-hours support.
• Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, structural, and electronic issues on-site.
• Perform post-repair audits to ensure safety features are functional.
• Document findings and recommend corrective actions, including safety notifications to customers.
• Consult with customers on repair and safety issues, offering recommendations for material handling improvement.
• Produce electronic documentation using company tools, obtaining customer signatures.
• Stay updated on industry codes and regulations (OSHA, ANSI, CMAA, HMI).
• Complete service reports and other required documents accurately and promptly.
• Communicate with the Field Operations Manager and Service Coordinator following established practices
• Maintain company-issued equipment, vehicles, and assets in proper working order.
• Operate tools, equipment, and vehicles, reporting deficiencies to the supervisor.
• Follow established safety rules and procedures, including customer guidelines.
• Participate in monthly safety meetings.
• Perform other responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.

Education: High School Diploma required. Associate degree in Industrial Electrical and/or Mechanical Technology or related field preferred or equivalent vocational/technical training and experience.

Experience: Minimum one (1) year experience involving electrical troubleshooting and mechanical repair. Some electronic experience but not necessary. Prior experience with cranes is a benefit, but not required.

Other Requirements: Must have and maintain a good driving record, including a valid driver's license. Must be willing to work off the ground. Can work varied overtime, as needed by customer, be available for "on call" as part of the service office rotation and be able to travel and work out of town, on occasion.

Must be able to frequently lift to 25 lbs. Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. on a daily basis. Must be able to lift to 75 lbs. although not on a daily basis. Must be able to lift 100 lbs. on a rare basis. This position requires frequent climbing, balancing, stooping/crouching, and overhead reaching. This position requires occasional pushing, pulling, kneeling, and crawling. This position will be inside approximately 90% of the time and outside approximately 10% of the time. This position will be frequently exposed to heat, cold, noise and heights.

Salary: $22 - $48 an hour - Pay is determined based on skills, geographic location, internal equity, market/data analysis, number of years of prior relevant experience, degrees and/or certifications, technical assessment score, etc.

Company Vehicle: Our Service Technicians get a work truck and a gas card to be used for business purposes. Candidates must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.

Benefits: Medical Plan, Dental, Vision, 401k plan with a match from day one, identity theft protection, accident insurance, travel insurance and so much more!

Vacation: 2 weeks of vacation per year (pro-rated for the first year depending on start date). 5-12 years of service, 3 weeks. 13+ years of service, 4 weeks.

Sick Leave: 5 days of Sick Leave per year. Pro-rated the first year after 90 days of service

Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

Join us in building a world-class, in-house AV production team and help create exceptional live experiences for some of the world's most discerning clients. This is your opportunity to design and deliver bespoke productions where every detail matters and excellence is the standard.

From elegant galas and luxury weddings to award ceremonies, runway fashion shows, large-scale corporate gatherings, and other premier live events, you'll play a pivotal role in bringing extraordinary moments to life. • Safety Compliance: Adhere to safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a safe working environment for all staff and guests.

• Proficiency in operating audio equipment, including mixing consoles, microphones, speakers, Dante Network management, and playback devices. Familiarity with digital audio workstations (DAWs) and audio editing software is a plus.

• Excellent attention to detail with a strong ear for sound quality and precision.

• Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to quickly resolve technical issues.

• Effective communication and interpersonal skills to work collaboratively with team members and clients.

jobs.title: Service Manager
jobs.description:
At Cortland, we operate with a forward-thinking approach that challenges conventional norms and actively seeks insights beyond traditional industry boundaries. As a recognized leader in the multifamily sector, our focus on performance, innovation, and disciplined execution continues to drive strong growth and market leadership. We are committed to building a best-in-class organization by empowering top talent with the resources, autonomy, and support needed to deliver results and advance their careers in a high-performance environment.

Role Overview

As the Service Manager, you are responsible for leading the maintenance team and ensuring the physical integrity, safety, and overall functionality of a multimillion‑dollar multifamily community. You oversee all maintenance operations, guide preventative programs, manage workflow and staffing, and ensure timely, high‑quality service that supports resident satisfaction and asset preservation. This role combines strong technical expertise with leadership, organization, and exceptional customer service.

Maintenance Leadership & Technical Expertise

• Diagnose and resolve complex maintenance issues across electrical, plumbing, HVAC, appliance, structural, lighting, and security systems.

• Ensure the community operates efficiently by proactively identifying areas needing repair or improvement.

• Guide the team in anticipating and preventing resident issues through consistent upkeep and early problem detection.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for creating a safe, reliable, and worry‑free living environment.

Team Management & Performance Oversight

• Support a team of maintenance technicians, ensuring timely, high‑quality completion of routine maintenance and repairs.

• Provide training, guidance, and mentorship, encouraging adherence to safety protocols and company standards.

• Assign and prioritize daily tasks, inspect completed work, and step into complete hands‑on repairs when necessary.

• Promote a strong safety culture with continuous attention to hazards, preventative actions, and compliance.

• Help manage the on-call rotation and provide support during emergency situations.

Organization, Budget & Vendor Coordination

• Oversee service request management, preventive maintenance schedules, and maintenance records.

• Track, manage, and allocate the maintenance budget, ensuring efficient use of resources.

• Maintain supply and parts inventory to support timely completion of work orders.

• Coordinate with outside vendors, ensuring timely, quality service and adherence to scope and budget.

The Team Leader

• Fearlessly lead a team of technicians as they perform routine preventive maintenance and make timely, high-quality repairs

• Share your wisdom and insights with the team, prioritize their tasks, make sure they follow protocol, and motivate them to go above and beyond the call of duty

• Oversee and inspect your team’s work, and sometimes perform the tasks yourself

• Make sure your team is constantly on the lookout for areas of concern, using our “safety first” motto

The Organizer

• Keep track of a crazy number of details without feeling like your head might explode

• Act as the gatekeeper of maintenance information — tracking and assigning everything from resident service requests to preventive maintenance records

• Manage to keep the service vendors, maintenance budget, and supplies inventory on track

Qualifications

• 3-5+ years of experience in maintenance, including carpentry, plumbing, electrical, and HVAC; Multifamily experience preferred.

• High school diploma or equivalent required; technical training or college coursework preferred.

• Leadership skills with the ability to train, mentor, and manage a maintenance team.

• Universal EPA and CPO certifications are required.

• Valid Class E driver’s license.

• Knowledge of applicable laws and regulations including EPA, OSHA, ADA, and Fair Housing.

• Ability to read and interpret maintenance instructions, technical manuals, and equipment documentation.

• Strong customer‑service and communication skills.

• Ability to work evenings, weekends, and participate in on‑call rotations as needed.

• Physical ability to perform maintenance tasks including lifting, climbing, and working indoors/outdoors.

Founded in 2005, Cortland is an international, vertically integrated multifamily real estate investment, development, and management firm with a resident-centric approach to living experiences. Recognized as one of the top 10 multifamily owners and operators in the US, Cortland combines in-house design, construction, and operations to deliver value and innovation across its portfolio.

jobs.description:
Tomorrow.io's engineering department is focused on building life changing software and products at scale, from infrastructure that handles massive amounts of data to outstanding customer-centric user experiences in B2B, B2C and B2D products that change billions of lives worldwide.

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to power the reliability, security, and efficiency of the world's most impactful weather platform. Your work will be guided by four core pillars- Security, Cost, SLOs, and Developer Experience- with AI acting as a force multiplier across each. You'll build self-service platforms that give developers and weather scientists true independence, weave AI into how we operate, and work side-by-side with R&D to push performance and scale further. Our environment spans two worlds: cloud-native product services on Kubernetes, and scientific computing on HPC clusters- and you'll help both thrive. You'll evolve our cloud infrastructure to match the pace of the business, hold the line on cost, and stay close to production through on-call. The people who thrive here bring a product mindset, take ownership without waiting to be asked, and leave the people and systems around them better than they found them.

As a DevOps Engineer at Tomorrow.io, You'll:

• Develop and adopt AI-powered tools to make Development and Operations processes more efficient

• Collaborate with weather scientists, engineers, and Spacecraft Mission Operations Engineers to optimize service performance, reliability, scale, security, and cost

• Evolve and maintain adaptive cloud infrastructure to support our business strategy and enable smooth growth at scale

• Build self-service platforms for scientists and developers to work independently

• Support scientific computing workloads on HPC clusters (SLURM) alongside our cloud-native Kubernetes platforms

• Introduce and integrate MLOps practices for GPU-based model deployment on Kubernetes

• Maintain Production availability by participating in DevOps on-call shifts

What you bring:

• At least 6 years of experience as a Platform/DevOps/SRE Engineer in a containerized cloud environment experienced with AWS, GCP, or Azure and IaC, such as Terraform or Crossplane

• Experience in fast-growing, cloud-native startup or scale-up environments

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability for service reliability

• Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents; experience building agentic workflows is a plus

• 10X mindset - always looking for the fastest, smartest path to a high-quality result

• Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Copilot, etc.)- must; building agentic DevOps workflows- a plus

• Experience with CI/CD tools and deployment methodologies in Kubernetes

• Experience implementing and customizing monitoring systems (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack)

• Experience working in an agile environment with high-velocity teams

• Proficiency with scripting languages like Python, Node.js, and Go

• Adaptable problem-solving mindset - thriving in changing environments and requirements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across distributed teams, time zones, and multiple R&D stakeholders

Bonus:

• Experience with HPC / scientific computing- e.g., Slurm, AWS ParallelCluster, Azure CycleCloud

• Familiarity with parallel filesystems- e.g., Lustre, NFS

If you take pride in what your infrastructure enables-  faster science, reliable operations, a better product and you'd rather ship something useful this week than something perfect this quarter, this is the place for you. You'll join a small global team with real ownership and room to grow, help shape how a fast-moving company builds and operates with AI, and work alongside engineers and scientists solving problems most infrastructure teams never get near-  from forecast models to satellites.

If you have reached this point and you are super excited but not sure you check all the boxes - we still want to speak with you! Your passion is priceless. Other things can be learned.

• Support the Director of Tax Services in leading and mentoring Senior Tax Specialists and Tax Specialists, responsibilities include delivering training on tax law updates, and regulatory compliance and operational procedures, as well as reviewing work for accuracy and completeness.

• Confident Humility – a quintessential team player, willing to do whatever it takes to get the job done, with pragmatic optimism

• Contagious Growth Mindset – a continuous learner with intellectual curiosity who strives for excellence and inspires others

• Strong organizational skills with proven ability to manage high-volume workflow and meet deadlines

• Strong attention to detail with commitment to accuracy when reviewing complex tax returns

• High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential information

• This role offers a hybrid work arrangement throughout the year; however, full-time onsite attendance is required during the tax season. The position also requires flexibility to work extended hours during peak workload periods to ensure timely completion of client deliverables and compliance deadlines.

jobs.title: Brands Analyst
jobs.description:
About Dutchie

Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.

Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.

About This Job

The Brands Ad Analyst is a critical partner to the Dutchie Ads sales team, sitting at the intersection of data analytics, client services, and digital advertising strategy. This role is responsible for equipping the sales team with the data and narratives they need to win new business and retain existing clients. You will build compelling, data-driven stories that demonstrate the impact of advertising on Dutchie’s platform, deliver strategic recommendations for campaign optimization, and serve as a trusted analytical voice in client-facing conversations.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable writing SQL queries in Snowflake, building dashboards in visualization tools, and presenting performance insights to brand partners. You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and bring a consultative mindset to every interaction.

What You'll Do…

New Business Support

• Develop data-driven prospect briefs identifying high-potential brand targets based on market share, category penetration, and competitive positioning

• Build budget recommendations and media plans grounded in historical performance benchmarks and retailer-level data

• Create compelling pitch materials, including performance projections and ROI scenarios, to support the sales team in new business presentations

Existing Business – Monthly & Quarterly Reporting

• Own the end-to-end production of monthly performance narratives for brand clients, translating raw ad data into clear, strategic stories for client review meetings

• Conduct quarterly deep-dive analyses evaluating campaign health, incrementality, share of voice, and consumer behavior trends

• Frame insights around business outcomes—connecting ad spend to ROAS, new buyer acquisition, market dollar share, and conversion rate improvements

Dashboard & Visualization

• Design and maintain client-facing dashboards and internal reporting tools using visualization platforms such as Hex or Looker

• Develop reusable templates and automated workflows to streamline monthly and quarterly reporting cycles

• Ensure data accuracy and consistency across all deliverables through rigorous QA processes

Strategic Partnership

• Serve as the analytical voice in client meetings, confidently presenting findings and fielding data questions from brand stakeholders

• Provide strategic recommendations for new campaign launches, budget reallocations, and placement optimizations based on performance data

• Quantify the cost of inaction—translate ad spend pauses or reductions into measurable performance impact to reinforce the value of sustained investment

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Testing

• Work closely with Sales, Ad Operations, and Product teams to align on priorities, surface data needs, and communicate insights across the organization

• Participate in product testing for new ad placements, targeting features, and platform capabilities, providing structured feedback grounded in performance data

• Support ad hoc analytical requests from the sales team with quick, accurate turnarounds

What You Bring...

Required

• 3-5+ years of experience in digital advertising analytics, media analytics, ad operations, or a related data-driven role

• Proficiency in SQL with hands-on experience querying large datasets (Snowflake strongly preferred)

• Strong data storytelling ability—you can turn a table of numbers into a narrative that drives action

• Comfort in client-facing settings: you can present findings clearly and handle questions with confidence

• Experience working cross-functionally with sales, operations, and product teams

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables across clients and deadlines

Technical Skills:

• Use snowflake or Hex to maintain, update and create ad reporting for client reviews

• Be familiar with the following schemas:

• Ad platform Data

• POS Data

• Telemetry Data

• Product Data

• Retailer Data

• Understand how all of the following relate to each other in order to build:

• Market Share Reports

• Market Impact Reports

• QBRs

• Ad Metric Reporting

• Ad Incrementality Reporting

• Retailer Level Reporting

• Be familiar enough with the data to quickly and accurately pull insights (ad projections, store lists, state rollups etc.) for sales and product teams

• Understand ads, snowflake and the data to write queries to test impact of campaign optimizations

• Work with Product team to rewrite incrementality report with A-B testing using ad server and user level data

It’s a Bonus if You…

• Experience with data visualization tools such as Hex, Looker, or similar BI platforms

• Background in media, digital advertising (retail media, programmatic, display, or sponsored product ads)

• Familiarity with ad performance metrics including ROAS, CTR, incrementality, share of voice, and conversion rate

• Experience with presentation tools (PowerPoint, Google Slides) for building polished client-ready decks

• Exposure to cannabis, CPG, or retail media industries is a plus

You’ll Get…

We are targeting a starting salary of $107,000 - $178,000 based on the intended level for this role.

In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes:

• Full medical benefits including dental and vision plans to ensure you always have the best care.

• Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees.

• Technology (hardware, software, reading materials, etc..) allowance

• Flexible vacation and sick days

At Dutchie, we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Dutchie believes that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

jobs.title: Immigration Pro Bono Coordinating Attorney
jobs.description:
Legal Services NYC (LSNYC) fights poverty and seeks racial, social and economic justice for low-income New Yorkers. For over 50 years, we have challenged systemic injustices that trap people in poverty and provided legal services that help our clients meet basic needs for housing, income and economic security, family and immigration stability, education, and health care. LSNYC is the largest civil legal services provider in the country; our staff of more than 600 people in neighborhood-based offices and outreach sites across all five boroughs helps hundreds of thousands of New Yorkers annually. We partner with scores of community-based and client-run organizations, elected officials, public agencies, pro bono lawyers, and the courts to maximize our effectiveness. Our work fights discrimination and helps to achieve equity for all low-income New Yorkers.

LSNYC employees have numerous opportunities for growth and professional development, including access to our internal Justice Learning Center, which provides opportunities to earn free CLEs and gain experience as a trainer.

Immigration Pro Bono Coordinating Attorney
New York, NY

LSNYC’s Pro Bono Program

LSNYC’s Pro Bono Program engages a range of private partners on behalf of thousands of low-income New Yorkers across multiple practice areas. Managed by a director, two deputy directors, three other immigration attorneys, a bankruptcy attorney, three housing and public benefits attorneys, and five paralegals, the Pro Bono Program works with LSNYC staff and pro bono partners to create and manage pro bono projects, place cases, run clinics, train and mentor volunteers, access in-kind resources, and match individual volunteers with appropriate LSNYC offices. LSNYC’s private partners include nearly 125 law firms and corporations, along with law schools, bar associations, and individual volunteers. Last year we worked with more than 5,000 volunteers and secured donated time valued at nearly $100 million.

Immigration makes up about half of our pro bono work. We conduct more than 100 pro bono immigration clinics and study groups each year, which are primarily the launch of full representation engagements for volunteers. Collectively, our pro bono immigration initiatives serve more than one thousand low-income New Yorkers. This work compliments a dozen other non-immigration pro bono initiatives focused on housing, public benefits, transgender name changes, and more. We operate a high-volume practice, with more than 5,000 pro bono cases annually at law firms, impacting thousands of New Yorkers each year.

Opportunity

As immigration enforcement has intensified—including increased detention of our current clients—our program is expanding its capacity to respond. We are seeking an experienced immigration attorney to mentor pro bono attorneys in detained and removal cases, and to provide training and mentorship on cases in our longstanding pro bono immigration work: LGBTQ+ asylum, VAWA Self-Petition & Battered Spouse Waiver, U visa, Special Immigrant Juvenile Status, adjustment of status, family preparedness, and naturalizations. The ideal candidate will also bring federal litigation skills, including habeas corpus petitions, to our practice.

The Immigration Pro Bono Coordinating Attorney will work with the Pro Bono Director, Pro Bono Deputy Director, and other Immigration Pro Bono Coordinating Attorneys and paralegals to expand and operate pro bono immigration clinics, trainings, mentoring, and case placements.

We are searching for an applicant who is innovative, highly organized, responsive, skilled at public speaking, experienced with leading teams and managing a high volume of pro bono cases, and a problem-solver with strong interpersonal skills.

Under the supervision of the Pro Bono Deputy Director, the Immigration Pro Bono Coordinating Attorney’s duties will include:

• Provide expert legal support for pro bono attorneys who are representing clients on immigration matters, including removal proceedings, habeas petitions, affirmative asylum, VAWA, U visa, SIJS, adjustment of status, family preparedness and naturalization.
• Provide expert legal support for pro bono attorneys who file habeas corpus petitions in federal district court on behalf of clients who are unlawfully detained
• Administer frequent (primarily virtual) pro bono clinics with law firms
• Conduct regular trainings for pro bono attorneys and other volunteers
• Develop and improve training materials for pro bono attorneys
• Coordinate first and second-level screening of prospective clients
• Draft case descriptions to pitch to pro bono attorneys
• Coordinate with volunteers to place and follow up on cases
• Research and assist with outreach and policy updates to law firms and corporations
• Assist with program evaluation
• Assist with development of new immigration pro bono programs to expand services
• Participate in and assist with pro bono events
• Maintain databases and case tracking, with support from other members of the pro bono team
• Oversee regular reporting to the key funder for this position
• Maintain a small direct representation caseload

Applicants must have the following qualifications:

• At least 5 years of experience as an immigration attorney
• Demonstrated experience and expertise in removal defense (including asylum and VAWA cancellation), bond hearings, and detained docket matters
• Experience with federal litigation, including drafting court briefs and motions, and habeas corpus petitions
• Experience with affirmative asylum, VAWA Self-Petitions, Battered Spouse Waivers, U-visas, adjustment of status, and naturalizations
• Track record of coordinating a high volume of clients and/or volunteers
• Collaborative mindset and team player
• Highly self-motivated
• Strong writing and analytical skills
• Demonstrated excellent organizational skills
• Consistent ability to pay close attention to details
• Excellent communication skills
• Demonstrated communication habits that are consistently prompt and highly responsive
• Ability to work with people from a range of backgrounds – including clients who are low-income, LSNYC staff, and attorneys from law firms and corporations
• Skilled presenter, with experience providing trainings on substantive legal issues
• Applicants must have a J.D. from an accredited law school and be admitted to the New York Bar

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience as a pro bono attorney at a large law firm or corporation
• Experience working with a pro bono program at a nonprofit
• Experience working with survivors of intimate partner violence and/or sexual assault
• Experience working with trans and gender nonconforming clients
• Experience implementing and operationalizing new initiatives/programs

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and we hope to fill this position as soon as possible. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply quickly.

Salary and benefits determined by the LSNYC Collective Bargaining Agreement.

LSNYC is an equal opportunity employer. People of color, women, people with disabilities, people over 40 and gay, lesbian, bisexual and transgender people are welcome and encouraged to apply.

Dependent on work history and experience.

Salary Range

$103,330—$169,852 USD

All employees are strongly encouraged to continue to receive and maintain up-to-date COVID vaccinations unless they are unable to for medical or religious reasons.

Legal Services NYC is an equal opportunity employer. People of color, women, people with disabilities, people over 40, and gay, lesbian, bisexual, and transgender people are strongly encouraged to apply.

LSNYC is the largest civil legal services provider in the country; our staff of more than 600 people in neighborhood-based offices and outreach sites across all five boroughs helps hundreds of thousands of New Yorkers annually. We partner with scores of community-based and client-run organizations, elected officials, public agencies, pro bono lawyers, and the courts to maximize our effectiveness. Our work fights discrimination and helps to achieve equity for all low-income New Yorkers.

LSNYC employees have numerous opportunities for growth and professional development, including access to our internal Justice Learning Center, which provides opportunities to earn free CLEs and gain experience as a trainer.

Deputy Director, Housing, Queens

Founded in 1967, QLS seeks equal access to justice for all low-income residents of Queens through a range of legal advocacy, education, and community partnerships. We provide free legal counseling, representation, and referrals in civil matters involving the essentials of life including housing, public and disability benefits, domestic violence prevention, consumer and homeowner protections, access to education, and employment rights to eligible low-income individuals and families. We work with our clients and partners to identify and address root causes for systemic inequalities in Queens and throughout New York City. We provide civil legal services from our office in Jamaica, Queens.

We are part of a network of local programs that make up Legal Services NYC, the largest free civil legal services provider in the United States.

Role & Responsibilties:

The Supervisor will join a vibrant practice in the heart of Southeast Queens, serving low-income tenants throughout the borough. We are looking for a candidate who is excited to work in a fast-paced environment on housing-related matters, including landlord/tenant actions, eviction defense, and affirmative litigation on behalf of tenants. Responsibilities include directly supervising several housing attorneys and staff, representing clients in the full range of housing matters handled by the HRP, and supporting its day-to-day functioning.

The Supervisor will oversee a committed team of attorneys and staff representing low-income and elderly Queens residents in housing matters and will be expected to work closely with tenant organizers, tenant associations, and community partners to identify and address housing needs. The attorney will work closely with the Housing Unit Director and other Supervisors to shape the direction of the HRP, develop and strengthen relationships with partner community-based organizations handle administrative and grant responsibilities, and identify systemic housing-related trends that could be affected by strategic litigation. The Supervisor will be expected to oversee and conduct weekly, evening, and weekend outreach and off-site intake with our partners. S/he will also be expected to support litigation and advocacy on a range of issues, coordinate building-wide and community-based litigation, and organize community education outreach and related initiatives.

The attorney will supervise regular appearances in civil, supreme, and federal court and administrative proceedings, review draft pleadings, motions, and court submissions, and support the filing of affirmative cases on behalf of tenants and tenant groups.

Experience & Qualifications:

We seek an attorney admitted to the New York State Bar with:

• A demonstrated passion for social justice and commitment to working with immigrant communities, communities of color, and low-income communities to advance equity;

• Excellent analytical, research, and writing skills;

• Demonstrated experience with housing advocacy;

• Demonstrated experience supervising legal work (preferred);

• Strong interpersonal, communication, time management, and organizational skills;

• Enthusiasm for and experience developing partnerships with community -based advocates and organizations;

• A facility working with software technology and proficiency in the entire MS Office suite;

• Experience with LegalServer or other case management systems (preferred); and

• Fluency or strong proficiency in Spanish, Mandarin, Cantonese, Bengali, or Korean (preferred).

• 2 or more years supervisory experience strongly preferred

• Familiarity with LSC rules and regulations (preferred)

How to Apply

Interested candidates should email a cover letter, resume, two recent writing samples, and the names of three references below. Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. No telephone calls, please.

Dependent on work history and experience.

Salary Range

$121,909—$193,748 USD

All employees are strongly encouraged to continue to receive and maintain up-to-date COVID vaccinations unless they are unable to for medical or religious reasons.

Legal Services NYC is an equal opportunity employer. People of color, women, people with disabilities, people over 40, and gay, lesbian, bisexual, and transgender people are strongly encouraged to apply.

Associate Vice President, Facilities Underwriting (Remote)

Company Description

Healthcare providers spend roughly $20B annually on premiums for medical professional liability  (“MPL”) insurance, $7B of which is spent by physicians. Primarily selling through brokers, insurance  carriers today often operate at an underwriting loss and employ outdated underwriting processes. The  current environment favors the entry of a new model featuring modern, data-driven underwriting with a  more efficient sales model targeting the best risks.

Indigo Technologies, backed by leading investors Rubicon Founders and Oak HC/FT, aims to address this issue by utilizing alternative data and artificial intelligence to more accurately price medical malpractice insurance. By offering potential cost savings, Indigo Technologies will enable providers to reallocate resources to invest more directly in patient care. We at Indigo are committed to creating enduring value by making a measurable impact on the healthcare industry

Position Description:

Reporting to the CUO, the AVP of Facilities Underwriting will assist in all underwriting staff/teams, processes, and methods in order to write profitable business, as well as address issues adversely affecting underwriting results (loss ratio). This role promotes and supports growth opportunities while maintaining underwriting integrity. They will be responsible for managing a variety of key stakeholders in an environment that is results-oriented, rigorous, and fast-paced. Responsibilities include the following areas (though not limited to):

Roles & Responsibilities:

• Work with the CUO, Product/Engineering, Data Science, Actuarial, Claims, and the broader organization to build our Indigo’s Facilities offering, including UW Guidelines, Appetite Guides, Forms/Endorsements, and related materials

• Support the business in the production, selection, pricing, control, and servicing of insurance policies, and assists in developing and maintaining a scalable and repeatable underwriting process using Indigo’s model

• Analyze, evaluate, and make underwriting decisions in line with underwriting guidelines and recommendations, coordinating with other underwriting staff

• Manages and evaluates new business submissions, renewals, and policy change requests for the book of business

• Review contract wordings and act as signatory of insurance contracts

• Review, evaluate and report on loss activity

• Understands and complies with relevant state statutory regulations and requirements

• Collaborates with business development to build, strengthen, and manage relationships with agents/brokers

• Brings a curious mindset and motivation to better understand and apply a new, data driven approach to underwriting

Qualifications:

• 5+ Years as a Sr. Underwriter in Facilities/Medical Professional Liability Insurance (10+ Years in Underwriting; certifications/designations a plus)

• Strong familiarity with Facility types, Facility rating methodologies, high-risk indicators for Facilities, and relevant Facilities underwriting or risk mitigations (e.g., exclusions)

• Good understanding of the Facilities segment, top carriers, and larger brokers

• Demonstrates an ability to operate with urgency and consistently meet processing deadlines per Underwriting Service Standards.

• Familiarity with relevant regulatory requirements

• Production Underwriting experience will be considered an asset

Desired characteristics:

Smart, detail-oriented, mission-driven, entrepreneurial and operates with urgency

jobs.title: Manager, Consumer Insights & Research

jobs.description:
The National Football League’s Marketing Strategy & Insights team serves as the voice of NFL fans within the various League offices and with stakeholders (e.g., Clubs, partners, agencies).  This team informs and authors strategic plans, ensuring grounding in consumer preferences and behaviors, marketplace dynamics, and evolving business priorities.  Marketing Strategy & Insights also leads Marketing department business planning and is responsible for influencing the entire NFL ecosystem to orient activities toward key fan base development and engagement initiatives.

The Consumer Insights & Research function within the team focuses on uncovering strategic insights that inform optimization across all business units and stakeholders.  The areas of coverage include (but are not limited to): global fan development, brand health, DE&I, media (e.g., direct-to-consumer, broadcasting), live events, in-stadium experiences, marketing effectiveness, legalized sports betting, corporate partnerships, social responsibility, player engagement, and player health and safety.  Team members design and conduct primary research (largely via third-party research partners) and leverage a myriad of syndicated data sources to measure relevant consumer preferences and behaviors.  They then generate robust insights tailored to informing key areas across the business.

The Manager of Consumer Insights position is responsible for leading the design and execution of primary research, with support from analysts and third-party vendors/agencies. This role serves as a strategic thought partner to key stakeholders, proactively shaping research agendas, driving alignment, and ensuring insights are translated into action to inform business decisions. The Manager is expected to manage complex workstreams across multiple stakeholders, and flex across priority business areas as needs evolve.

Responsibilities:

• Work with industry-leading research vendors to conduct qualitative and quantitative primary research initiatives that drive NFL fandom, deepen engagement, and create value for the League, the 32 Clubs, partners, and players. jobs.title: Senior MuleSoft Developer
jobs.description:
Buscamos incorporar un/a Senior MuleSoft Developer con experiencia sólida en las distintas soluciones del ecosistema MuleSoft. Este rol formará parte de nuestros equipos de desarrollo, colaborando en la construcción de soluciones de integración y datos de la más alta calidad funcional y técnica para nuestros clientes.

Si te apasiona diseñar e implementar soluciones robustas, escalables y de alto rendimiento, y quieres trabajar en un entorno dinámico donde tu criterio técnico tiene peso real, este reto es para ti.

Responsabilidades Principales

• Diseñar arquitecturas de integración MuleSoft bajo el enfoque API-Led Connectivity, alineadas con los objetivos técnicos y de negocio de cada cliente.
• Implementar soluciones técnicas de alta calidad, en cumplimiento de los requisitos funcionales y no funcionales definidos para cada proyecto.
• Supervisar la integración de APIs y flujos Mule, garantizando la correcta conectividad entre sistemas, así como su seguridad, escalabilidad y rendimiento.
• Participar activamente en equipos de desarrollo bajo metodologías ágiles (Scrum/Kanban), contribuyendo a la planificación, estimación y entrega continua.
• Colaborar en procesos de calidad: peer-review de código, documentación técnica y definición de estándares y buenas prácticas de gobernanza en Anypoint Platform.
• Apoyar y/o liderar el diseño técnico de integraciones: contratos de API, mapeos de datos, estrategias de error handling y resiliencia.
• Documentar APIs y activos reutilizables utilizando Anypoint Exchange y herramientas de diseño de MuleSoft.
• Interactuar con clientes de forma directa, recogiendo requisitos, comunicando avances y aportando soluciones orientadas al negocio.
• Mantener y dar soporte a soluciones existentes: debugging, optimización de rendimiento y mejora de la observabilidad.

Requisitos Mínimos

• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo de APIs e integraciones (implementación, testing, hardening).
• Dominio de MuleSoft Studio, DataWeave, MUnit, API Manager y Anypoint Exchange.
• Experiencia en diseño y gestión del ciclo de vida de APIs bajo el enfoque API-Led Connectivity.
• Conocimiento de RAML y/o OAS (OpenAPI) para el diseño y documentación de APIs.
• Experiencia en integración con sistemas heterogéneos: REST, SOAP, JDBC, (S)FTP, JMS, CRMs y ERPs.
• Conocimientos de seguridad aplicada: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, mTLS y uso de políticas de seguridad en MuleSoft.

• Integraciones asincronas, MuleSoft VM queues, colas de mensajería(RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus)...
• Revisión de Observabilidad en Anypoint Monitoring, logs de CloudHub, uso de herramientas de observabilidad como Elastic, Azure Monitor, Datadog...
• Capacidad de autogestión: organización eficaz de tareas, seguimiento proactivo y entrega sin supervisión constante.
• Habilidades de comunicación con cliente: escucha activa, presentación de soluciones y gestión de expectativas.Experiencia en liderazgo técnico: capacidad para guiar y supervisar a otros miembros del equipo, realizar revisiones de código, definir estándares técnicos y servir como referente para perfiles junior y mid.
• Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería, Big Data, o un campo relacionado.
• Idiomas: B1 mínimo de inglés.

Se Valorará Especialmente

• Actitud proactiva, ganas de aprender y de crecer profesionalmente dentro de un equipo técnico exigente y en constante evolución.
• Certificaciones oficiales de MuleSoft: MuleSoft Certified Developer (Level 1 o 2), MuleSoft Certified Platform Architect.
• Experiencia con Anypoint Platform en la nube: CloudHub 1.0/2.0, Runtime Fabric, despliegues híbridos.

• Uso de contenedores y orquestación: Kubernetes.

jobs.title: Industrial Electrician
jobs.description:
As an Industrial Electrician, you will be responsible for performing general upkeep on buildings' electrical systems. This entails inspecting the premises, performing routine maintenance and fixing any faulty wiring. Replacing electrical wires is necessary, so the ability to read blueprints and abide by the National Electric code is essential.

• Ability to utilize both mechanical skills and knowledge (pneumatics, hydraulics, bearings, power transmission, and lubrication) and electrical/electronic skills and knowledge (PLCs, A/C, D/C motors and drives, schematics) in our continuous process manufacturing environment to achieve machine uptime metrics.

• Inspect on a routine basis electrical equipment, wiring, fixtures and other components to ensure they remain functional and are up to code, as well as to identify any hazards or issues.
• Troubleshoot all type of equipment to determine the reasons for any malfunctions of systems or components and create a maintenance or repair plan to solve the problem.
• Perform major electrical repairs and installations from 480-volt buss down to co-component level. Repair electrical systems, wiring, circuit breakers, equipment and other components so that they remain at full functioning capacity.
• Test and repair all plant electrical facilities using devices such as voltmeters, oscilloscopes and ohmmeters to ensure the system remains safe and that components are compatible.
• Must be able to interpret complex electrical, mechanical and construction drawings and or schematics. Reviewing the blueprints/drawings to understand the placement of wiring or to comprehend the working of the equipment to provide the right service and repairs.
• Provide suggestions on the lifespan of equipment and other electrical components, advising when certain components should be replaced due to potential risks. Also, provide modifications to plant equipment to increase production capacity of equipment.
• Keep records of all maintenance and repair work conducted, including a record of any supplies ordered and used.
• Installs conduit and electrical wiring for machinery and cranes.
• Ensure all routine maintenance work is handled on a regular schedule to reduce the risk of larger and more complex issues and to reduce costs.
• Must have ability to obtain Journeyman Electricians card.
• Crane inspector card is a plus.
• Be an active participant in the safety process and practice safe work habits at all times by the guidelines of the NAFP 70E regulation.

Must possess tools necessary to perform the duties outlined

Education

• High School Diploma and 4 years of Electrical Trade School
• Must be familiar with standard shop math

Experience

• Prefer 3-5 years of experience in electrical maintenance
• Relevant electrician certification or license
• Familiar with the National Electric Code
• Interpersonal Skills
• Technical Skills
• Must have experience using voltmeters, oscilloscopes and ohmmeters
• Basic computer knowledge is required: Microsoft Office
• Other Skills Ability to effectively plan and organize
• Ability to communicate with others

Essential Functions

• The ability to predictably and regularly attend work and to be punctual
• The ability to work autonomously with little supervision
• The ability to follow direction or instruction
• Ability to write in a clear and concise manner
• Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Director
jobs.description:
Most of what makes American healthcare expensive isn’t medical care. It’s the machinery wrapped around it: middlemen taking a cut, fraud nobody stops, and billing systems designed to fight over payment instead of deliver care. The result is higher premiums, denied claims, surprise bills, and a system patients increasingly experience as adversarial.



Arlo is rebuilding health insurance for small businesses from first principles: making sure as much of every premium dollar as possible goes to care instead of getting absorbed by the system around it. We do that by identifying fraud earlier, steering members toward higher-quality and lower-cost care, automating operational overhead, and eliminating vendors whose business exists mostly to take a cut.



AI is the foundation that makes this work. We use it across underwriting, operations, clinical programs, and member experience to build an insurer that becomes more efficient as the technology improves.



We’re already operating at meaningful scale: profitable, hundreds of millions in premiums, tens of thousands of members covered, and growing quickly through brokers, employers, and partners. Backed by Upfront Ventures, 8VC, and General Catalyst, with a team from Palantir, YC companies, and longtime healthcare operators.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are building an AI-native health plan and need to build several functions, capabilities and teams over the course of the next few months and years. Your role will be to beachhead these initiatives, bring them from 0 to 1 and set them up for success. You will be working directly with Arlo's founders to act as a thought partner, lead strategic, cross-functional projects and spin up new functions. Here are some example projects you would be leading:

 - Design and drive key marketing experiments

 - Setup a clinical team

 - Architect partnerships with key distribution partners

 - Setup an insurance captive company





WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Execute on Strategic Projects: Plan and execute key initiatives in close collaboration with Arlo's founders

 - Spin up new functions: Design, build and operationalize new functions (prototype & run new processes/ capabilities, define new team roles, manage transition from "prototype into production")

 - Recruit, Onboard and Scale new Teams: You will be working closely with Arlo's talent lead to ensure your new functions are properly staffed. onboarded and can thrive moving forward.

 - Strategic Support: Support founders with planning, decision making and operational follow-through





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience in a high-intensity settings (consulting, investment banking, high growth startup, etc.)

 - Ability to operate as a generalist and learn extremely fast to dive deep into a topic (T-shaped profile).

 - Strong bias for action, sense of ownership, and ability to dive into the weeds.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable working with metrics and data.

 - High emotional intelligence, integrity, and collaborative spirit.

 


PROCESS

This is what you can expect when we like your application:

 - 30 minute call with Rachelle (Talent Lead)

 - 30-min call with Karthik (Co-Founder)

 - Take-home case study

 - Onsite/ Virtual Onsite

 - Reference Calls

 


COMPENSATION

$165,000 – $215,000 per year + equity




WHY JOIN ARLO:



 - High ownership: You’ll get real responsibility from day one—our high-trust team empowers you to run with big problems and shape core parts of the company.

 - Join an important mission: Your work directly influences how people access care and improves lives at scale.

 - Growth & expansion: We’re moving fast, and as we grow, your scope will grow with us—new challenges, bigger opportunities, and rapid career velocity.

 - Apply AI to a problem that matters: Instead of optimizing ads or cutting labor costs, you’ll use AI to fundamentally reimagine how people get healthcare.

 - High pace, high collaboration: We operate with velocity, first-principles thinking, and a team that works closely, openly, and with ambition.

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!



As a Territory Sales Manager, you will own a defined international territory and be responsible for generating mainly new business across research institutes, universities, national laboratories and commercial quantum computing companies. You will also build and manage strategic relationships with ecosystem partners, distributors and technology partners that help expand QuantWare’s reach.

You’ll work closely with the field, application engineer and product teams to bring cutting-edge quantum technology to organizations shaping the future of computing.



What you'll be doing

 - Own and grow an assigned international territory.

 - Develop and execute a territory plan to exceed revenue targets.

 - Generate new opportunities through outbound prospecting, conferences, industry networks and referrals.

 - Build relationships with professors, principal investigators, research directors and technical decision-makers.

 - Manage the complete sales cycle from first contact through contract signature.

 - Coordinate complex technical evaluations with our engineering and applications teams.

 - Build and expand strategic channel and technology partnerships.

 - Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting in HubSpot.

 - Provide structured market feedback to Product, Marketing and Leadership.
   
   

Your Profile

 - 5+ years of enterprise B2B technology sales experience.

 - Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota.

 - Experience selling complex technical solutions.

 - Strong hunter mentality with exceptional prospecting skills.

 - Experience working with channel partners and strategic alliances.

 - Willingness to travel internationally.
   
   

Nice to have

 - Experience in quantum computing, semiconductors, photonics, scientific instrumentation, deep tech or advanced hardware.

 - Experience selling into publicly funded research organizations.

 - Knowledge of government procurement or grant-funded purchasing processes.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. If this role excites you and you believe you can make an impact, we'd love to hear from you!

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know this helps us with better decisions, more innovation, and strengthens our culture. In particular, we’d love to see more women in the quantum industry!

So if you’re a female talent, excited about this opportunity but don’t meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

jobs.title: Machine Operator: Punch and Pack - Abrasives - PA4 - 3rd shift
jobs.description:
Aiding to the production process by assisting in the operation of the sand paper punching machine successfully. Responsible for gaining and maintaining general knowledge of machines throughout the conversion area. You will be responsible for completing the required training measures (PQ&T) as they are needed. You are responsible for maintaining the appropriate process systems, 6S and production standards. As a Bosch Associate, you will be expected to maintain a positive work environment and follow the appropriate safety procedures. You must be open and willing to assist others throughout the department.

Must be flexible and able to adapt quickly

General Math skills

Ability to multitask

Ability to stand for 8 hours

Ability to read and follow instructions

Ability to lift (up to) 40lb. boxes

High School Diploma or GED required

Prefer experience in machine operating

Load rolls of sandpaper on machine as needed

Use SAP to look up materials

Operate pin lift, pallet lift, and hoist

Assist in the set up and start up of the machine and operate successfully

Assist in making adjustments to machine as needed

Assist in the troubleshooting of machine issues and assist with repairs according to escalation plan

Reading and following standard operating procedures pertaining to the machine being operated

Follow the appropriate quality standards and measures for the machine being operated

Understand and following procedures pertaining to machine cleanliness and tool organization

Maintaining knowledge of all safety procedures associated with the machine being operated

Machine has a feeding system by clamp beam working on idle conveyor, the system is motorized. The feeding clamp beams are placed one before and one after cutting head.

Touch screen parameters provide the possibility to set material width in between the cuts (trim), to have the minimum waste as possible. A recipe menu provide the possibility to save machine setup data for each combination: shape size, master web width, material type, etc. The operator has only to recall the desired recipe to start a new machine setup.

jobs.title: Customer Service Rep/Expediter (06228)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You got game? You got spring in your step? You want the best job in the world! And schedules that work with you, not against you? That's right, we live to beat the rush and make it possible to make, bake or take pizzas during the hungry hours of the day and night, part or full time. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, hanging with your friends, or whatever. Sound good? Even if you just need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

We are searching for qualified customer service reps with personality and people skills. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, drop us a line. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From customer service representative to management, General Manager to Manager Corporate Operations or Franchisee, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You must be 16 years of age or older.

General job duties for all store team members

• Operate all equipment.
• Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.
• Prepare product.
• Receive and process telephone orders.
• Take inventory and complete associated paperwork.
• Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.
• Expedite carryout and delivery orders to vehicles.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the

phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).
• Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.
• Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.
• Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to:

• Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.
• In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.
• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.
• Fumes from food odors.
• Exposure to cornmeal dust.
• Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.
• Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.
• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

• Talking and hearing on telephone.
• Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.
• Depth perception.
• Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing: Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking: For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

• Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
• Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
• Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

• Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
• Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
• Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

• To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
• Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

• Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
• Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
• Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
• Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

• Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
• Workers reach above 72"occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
• Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
• Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

• Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
• Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.
• Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
• Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
• Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
• Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.
