You will play a key role in making sure our teams have the right tools, access and hardware to do great work from day one.

Moreover, you will help define and operationalize our Workplace IT function by improving processes, documentation and service quality as we continue to scale.




YOU WILL:

 - Own employee onboarding and offboarding together with People and hiring managers by provisioning devices, accounts and role-based access on time, so new joiners can be productive from day one and leavers are deprovisioned securely and reliably.

 - Manage the full hardware lifecycle with employees, vendors and internal stakeholders, including ordering, enrollment, repairs, returns and inventory tracking, so lemon.markets maintains a reliable, compliant and audit-ready device estate.

 - Operate and improve core workplace systems such as Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian and device management tooling in collaboration with Engineering and business teams, so employees have secure, consistent access to the tools they need every day.

 - Support employees across the company by troubleshooting day-to-day workplace IT issues and coordinating practical solutions with relevant partners and teams, so blockers are resolved quickly and people can stay focused on their work.

 - Improve workplace IT processes with People, Compliance and Technology Foundations by documenting procedures, refining service desk workflows and simplifying repetitive tasks, so operations scale with less manual effort and better service quality.

 - Collaborate with Compliance, ICT Risk and Technology Foundations to execute access management, device compliance, and workplace controls, so lemon.markets meets its regulatory obligations while maintaining a secure employee environment.


YOU WILL BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE IF:

 - You will be successful if:
   
   - You have first hands-on experience in Workplace IT, Internal IT, IT Operations or a similar role, and you are excited to keep building your skills in a hands-on environment.
   
   - You have hands-on experience with Apple/macOS device management tools such as Jamf, Kandji or JumpCloud, and you are comfortable working with managed devices, policies and day-to-day endpoint operations.
   
   - You have experience supporting employee onboarding and offboarding, hardware provisioning and day-to-day IT support, and you care about creating a smooth and reliable employee experience from day one.
   
   - You have administered tools such as Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian, and you communicate clearly with employees and stakeholders to keep workplace systems running effectively.
   
   - You understand the importance of access management, device compliance and structured operational processes in a regulated environment, and you bring a reliable, detail-oriented approach to operational work.
   
   - You enjoy improving repetitive workflows and are excited to automate or simplify manual tasks with a curious, pragmatic mindset, while staying focused on solutions that are useful, secure and scalable.
   
   - You are collaborative and service-minded. You work well with others and care about enabling teams to do their best work.
   
   - You understand what working in a startup or a similar lean organisation is like. You are able to work with a small team in a lean environment, can move quickly and focus on what's truly important.
   
   - You see yourself reflected in the skills above, or you see yourself growing into this path.

We're looking for people with passion, desire to learn and that are team players. You're encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out, and set you apart, especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns.




HOW WE TAKE CARE OF YOU:

 - 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to http://lemon.markets/lemon.markets.

 - 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

 - 🏢 Hybrid work setup: Because this role requires regular in-person collaboration in our Berlin office, we are currently only considering candidates based in Berlin. We offer flexibility for remote work, but the nature of this role requires a regular onsite presence in our Berlin office

 - 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, plus a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations so you always know where you stand, and what to do to level up.

 - 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day, Friday food market strolls at Maybachufer, and our monthly new-joiner breakfast. But also in the bigger things: celebrating the onboarding of new partners, growing our teams, and owning a strong discussion culture.

 - 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

 - 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

You have any questions? Feel free to contact us via talent@lemon.markets.com

jobs.title: Maintenance Operations Engineering Technician
jobs.description:
About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

About You and The Role

Zipline builds autonomous delivery systems that move essential goods. As a Maintenance Operations Engineering Technician in Esparto, California, you will keep prototype flight vehicles, ground infrastructure, and test equipment safe, configured, and ready for engineering development and field operations.

You will own hands-on maintenance and test execution: replacing components, preparing vehicles and test setups, running endurance campaigns, and isolating first-order issues. Your work enables safe test execution, reliable data capture, accurate configuration records, and evidence engineers use for design and vehicle-readiness decisions.

This role is based on site in Esparto, California, with flexibility required to support testing operations at other locations across the United States.

What You'll Do

• Maintain prototype aircraft, ground infrastructure, and test equipment to keep approved test campaigns executable and vehicles available for engineering work.

• Replace vehicle components, perform checkouts, and maintain complete maintenance documentation and configuration records.

• Execute semi-automated vehicle checkouts, reliability campaigns, and endurance tests using documented procedures and repeatable setups.

• Prepare test articles, equipment, instrumentation, and data-acquisition systems so test specifications can be executed as written.

• Verify completed maintenance and test setups meet documented configuration, safety-check, instrumentation, and data-capture requirements before test execution.

• Independently isolate and document first-order test-system or test-article faults; surface deviations and escalate root-cause resolution to engineers.

• Produce test reports that connect observations and data to reliability improvements, design iterations, and vehicle-readiness decisions.

• Travel to support testing, maintenance, and operational needs at other Zipline locations across the United States.

What You'll Bring

• Experience operating common machine-shop equipment and building mechanical assemblies, fixtures, jigs, or test hardware.

• Hands-on experience with electrical and electronic assemblies across different power levels and component sizes.

• Experience setting up, instrumenting, executing, and documenting hardware or hardware/software tests alongside engineers.

• Ability to independently troubleshoot test issues to a first-order diagnosis and communicate clear evidence for engineering follow-up.

• Ability to interpret electrical specifications, mechanical drawings, test procedures, diagrams, and incomplete work instructions.

• Discipline in organizing test data, maintaining configuration records, and communicating findings clearly in writing and verbally.

• Ability to work rotating shifts, including nights and weekends, on site in Esparto, California.

• Ability to travel approximately 20% of the time, including trips of up to two weeks, to support testing operations across the United States.

What Else You Need to Know

The hourly range for this role is $32 - $42. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; overtime pay; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or other characteristics protected by state, federal or local law or our other policies.

We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply!

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer - dreamDEX
jobs.description:
About Somnia

The Somnia Foundation, backed by Improbable, specialises in building and operating high-performance decentralised technology. Its EVM L1, launched in 2025, has been benchmarked as the fastest on the planet: at over 1 million ERC-20 transactions per second.

You’ll join a talented team at Somnia, working across the core blockchain along with novel protocols leveraging its capabilities:

 - Somnia Agents adding the ability for smart contracts to leverage the latest open-source LLMs and interact with the outside world via headless browsers, powered by on-chain deterministic LLM inference and a decentralised network of agent runners

 - Prophecy an information oracle that can combine parsing of public websites and public data sources into decentralised, auditable attestations about the real world, powering prediction markets, forecasting and new types of financial systems

 - dreamDEX a high-performance DEX with a fully on-chain CLOB leveragingSomnia's core capabilities, targeting centralised exchange characteristics

 - Somnia L1 continued work on the high-performance EVM L1, including working on MEV resistance, privacy, automatic gas sponsorship and 'reactivity' where smart contracts can autonomously invoke themselves based on specific timing or event criteria

About the Role:

dreamDEX makes a hard claim: CEX execution without DEX custody. A fully on-chain CLOB with sub-10ms ambitions, zero trading fees, self-custody and transparent rules, competing head-on with Hyperliquid, Lighter and the large centralised exchanges.

We move customer funds on-chain, where a single settlement error - funds to the wrong account, a mispriced liquidation, a bad fill - have critical impact. Spot is live; perpetuals and event contracts are landing next. Every one of them has to clear a serious quality bar before it touches real money.

You'll own end-to-end testing across the entire system and ensure quality is up to the standard level before anything ships. You've done this on real perpetuals trading systems before, and you know exactly what 'wrong' looks like on an order book.

How We Operate

We move at startup speed with exchange-grade standards. We look for people who are proactive by default: you find the solution before being asked, unblock yourself, and get things done fast without ever trading away quality - on a venue holding customer funds, speed and correctness are both non-negotiable. You take full ownership of your area and treat every problem in it as yours to solve.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Own end-to-end test coverage across the system: order matching, settlement, margin and liquidation, deposits and withdrawals, the API surface and the frontend

 - Define the test strategy for every new product and feature before it ships: spot, perps and event contracts

 - Build automated test infrastructure, using AI to multiply your reach: generated test cases, agent-driven exploratory testing and LLM-assisted triage

 - Drive a edge-case testing: partial fills, reorg and oracle-deviation scenarios, liquidation cascades and the agent-driven attack surface (we run a live red-team scope for DoS and exploitation on testnet)

 - Communicate effectively and proactively with other parts of the organisation and drive discussions between different projects. Reporting is a massive part of what you do, you are constantly pushing information to those who need it in order to help them make better decisions.

 - Run regression and load testing against Somnia's throughput and latency profile

 - Drive defect management, ensuring issues are prioritised appropriately, root causes are understood and regressions cannot recur.

Requirements:

Must Have

 - 7+ years of QA experience on perpetuals trading systems: a perp DEX, or a perps CEX combined with strong Web3 experience

 - Fluency in the failure modes of matching engines, settlement and margin systems

 - Automation-first mindset with strong test-engineering skills

 - AI-native working style: you use AI tooling daily to write, generate and triage tests, and you're comfortable testing systems that agents trade on

 - Comfort operating hands-on in a fast-moving environment with significant ownership

Nice to Have

 - Smart-contract testing experience, fuzzing or a security-adjacent background

 - Experience testing REST / WebSocket trading APIs and bot or agent integrations

 - Experience taking a new venue or major trading product through its first launches

Why Join Somnia?

Design The Future: Join Somnia to work remotely with a global team, earn competitive compensation with token incentives, and help build the future of Web3 at a company where your impact truly matters.

First of its Kind: Make Somnia famous as the only hyperspeed L1 with native AI inference.

High Stakes: Influence a brand targeting a $1M+ launch budget in the 2026 peak-fragility market.

Incentives: Competitive salary + tokens.

Role Location

The role is remote, but we are looking for someone based on a UK-friendly timezone (+/- 4 hours).

jobs.title: Purchasing Manager

We are currently seeking a Purchasing Manager to join our vibrant team. At RHG, we are in search of individuals who go beyond the resume – those with character, skills, talents, and a passion for creating memorable experiences. We value mindset as pivotal: anticipating guest needs, supporting your department, and consistently delivering memorable experiences.

We are dedicated to nurturing and growing talent, offering pathways for advancement, and fostering a culture of continuous learning.

As a Purchasing Manager, you infuse our strategic sourcing endeavors with a heightened sense of ambition, a focus on delivering results, and a genuine passion for optimizing our procurement processes. Your dynamic approach and dedication significantly contribute to the success of our procurement team.

• Supports the smooth running of the procurement department, exerting diligent financial process control in accordance with company and business procedures.
• Works proactively with all key stakeholders to maximize guest satisfaction and comfort, ensuring the timely procurement of quality goods and services whilst delivering a positive and responsive approach to enquiries and problem resolution.
• Develops and implements procurement strategies where objectives are communicated at all levels, performance is measured accurately and reported upon in a timely manner.
• Manages the life cycle of the team within the department, fostering a culture of growth, development and performance.
• Responsible for the purchasing budget, ensuring that all purchasing functions and disciplines are controlled, audited and developed.
• Builds and maintains effective working relationships with all key stakeholders, suppliers and contractors to ensure continuity of supply, competitive pricing and agreed quality standards.
• Reviews and scrutinizes purchasing performance, supplier performance, objectives and standard purchasing practices, providing recommendations that drive financial performance, operational efficiency and added value.
• Ensures procurement activities are conducted in accordance with company policies, approved specifications and purchasing procedures, maintaining appropriate documentation, contracts and audit trails.
• Ensures inventory levels are effectively managed to support operational requirements whilst minimizing excess stock and maintaining agreed lead times for procurement.
• Maintains awareness of market trends, supplier developments and product innovations to support informed purchasing decisions and continuous improvement.
• Ensures adherence and compliance to all legislation where due diligence requirements and best practice activities are planned, delivered and documented for internal and external audit, performing follow-up as required.
• Any other reasonable duties that may be required from time-to-time.

• Excellent managerial skills with a hands-on approach and lead-by-example work style.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and build positive working relationships.
• Commitment to exceptional guest service with a passion for the hospitality industry.
• Ability to find creative solutions, offering advice and recommendations while effectively resolving operational challenges and conflicts.
• Ability to multitask and perform effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

jobs.title: Senior Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, AI
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be tasked with extending SentinelOne's engineering capacity directly into the departments that need it most — Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Security, People, Legal, and beyond. Unlike a platform or product engineer working behind a backlog, you'll embed with the stakeholders who own a problem, scope it end-to-end, and ship a working custom application into their hands — often in days or weeks, not quarters. This role blends hands-on full-stack engineering, rapid prototyping with modern AI tools, and the exceptional technical judgment to know when to build, when to reuse, and when to say no. You'll operate as a trusted, staff-level technical partner to functional leaders, turning highly ambiguous business needs into production-grade software that sticks.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

• Embed with a functional department for a defined engagement, running discovery to understand workflows and pain points before writing a line of code.

• Scope, design, and build full-stack custom applications — not just automations or scripts — using modern frameworks (typically Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, React/TypeScript, but also others), AI coding assistants, as well as internal platform APIs, and AI gateway, moving from prototype to production quickly.

• Own delivery end to end: high-level technical architecture, build, testing, deployment, and the training/handoff that gets a department to actually adopt what you built.

• Work hands-on in the code alongside AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to compress build cycles, iterating with stakeholders in near real time rather than through long requirements documents.

• Make explicit trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality as requirements shift, and communicate those trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and executive leadership.

• Partner with IT, Security, and Data teams so every deployed application meets SentinelOne's standards for data security, compliance, and long-term supportability.

• Codify recurring patterns, components, and playbooks from each engagement into reusable building blocks for the next department and for the broader engineering organization.

• Feed field learnings back to platform, product, and data teams — what worked, what broke, and what the next generation of internal tools should look like.

• Measure and report success through production adoption and measurable business impact, not lines of code shipped or tickets closed.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

• 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a demonstrated ability to independently architect, design, build, and ship full-stack applications (frontend and backend).

• Deep proficiency in at least one modern backend language (Python, Node.js/JavaScript, or comparable) and strong frontend capability (React/TypeScript) to build usable, highly polished internal tools without waiting on a dedicated design or frontend team.

• Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and LLM-based tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) to drastically accelerate development, plus an expert understanding of APIs, webhooks, data structures, and integration patterns.

• A proven track record of working directly with senior non-technical stakeholders — scoping highly ambiguous requests, managing expectations, and shipping production-grade software rather than slide decks.

• Comfort operating with significant autonomy and shifting priorities: this role moves between departments and problem spaces, and the "right" solution is rarely handed to you.

• Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to a functional VP or executive as easily as to a fellow engineer.

• Preferred: prior experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, professional services, or startup generalist role where you owned a project from discovery through production.

• Preferred: exposure to enterprise security, compliance, or data governance requirements, given the internal, security-conscious environment you'll be building in.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Salary starting from 5500 EUR/month. Annual bonus based on company performance, paid in two installments. The final base salary may be adjusted based on the individual skills and experience of the selected candidate.

Equity & Rewards

• Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

• Performance-based bonus

Time Off & Wellbeing

• Flexible time off, on top of the standard 5 weeks PTO

• Paid company wellness days and fully paid short-term sick/nursing leave

• Gender-neutral parental leave

Insurance & Financial Security

• Life and disability insurance

• Pension Insurance contribution

• Global business travel medical insurance

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Work Perks & Flexibility

• Global home office allowance

• Meal allowance

• Hybrid work in Prague (Karlin), Brno (Clubco) or remote in CZ/SK. Only Prague-based employees are required to work from the office at least 2 days//week.

Wellness & Lifestyle

• Wellbeing allowance

• MultiSport benefit program

• Wellness Coach app

SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

jobs.title: Leerling Keuken
Визуален Мърчандайзер Русе
jobs.description:
КАКВО ЩЕ ПРАВИШ

​

Като Визуален мърчандайзер ще се грижиш за създаването и поддържането на среда, която вдъхновява клиентите ни да откриват и развиват своя личен стил. Заедно с екипа на магазина ще работиш в посока осигуряване на най-вълнуващото преживяване за клиентите. Действайки в съответствие с нашите ценности, ще допринасяш както за своя успех, така и за този на компанията.

Ти ще:

• Следиш актуалните модни тенденции и техники за стилизиране, за да предвидиш нуждите на клиентите.
• Анализираш продажбите, идентифицираш възможности за подобрение, следиш за правилното презентиране на продуктите в магазина, заедно с мениджърския екип.
• Избираш нови таланти, провеждаш обучения и развиваш екипа, като същевременно насърчаваш приобщаваща култура, екипна работа, професионално развитие и иновативно мислене.
• Представяш себе си и компанията по позитивен начин по време на всяко взаимодействие с клиенти.
• Имаш възможност да вземеш участие в бъдещи проекти свързани с нашите магазини, подкрепяйки нашия Sales Market.
• Промотираш активно лоялната ни програма.

С КОГО ЩЕ РАБОТИШ

Магазините ни са сърцето на компанията – мястото, където клиентите се запознават с нашата марка от първа ръка. Като част от динамичния екип в магазина, всяка роля – от продавач-консултант и ръководител отдел до управител, визуален мърчандайзер и главен касиер – допринася за създаването на вдъхновяваща и приветстваща обстановка. Ще имаш възможност да си сътрудничиш с колеги от различни магазини, да обменяте опит и да постигате успехи заедно. Работейки с твоя екип, ще имаш ключова роля в това да помагаш на клиентите да се чувстват уверени и свободни да изразят себе си чрез най-новите модни тенденции и класически модели. Изграждайки значима връзка с клиентите в нашите магазини, ние създаваме достъпна и устойчива мода за всички.

КОЙ СИ ТИ

Ние търсим човек с…​

• ​Опит във визуалния мърчандайзинг в сферата на търговията.

• Познания за управление, анализ и действие, използвайки различни системи и отчети.

И човек, който е…​

• С проявен интерес към модните тенденции и динамиката на пазара.
• Мотивиран да създаде неповторимо клиентско преживяване, като с увереност препоръчва и продава нашите продукти.
• Комуникативен, креативен и любопитен.
• Уверен и вдъхновяващ лидер, който развива екипа си постигайки отлични резултати.
• Адаптивен, аналитичен и ориентиран към постигане на резултати.

КОИ СМЕ НИЕ

H&M Group е международна група от утвърдени модни марки и инициативи. Нашата цел е да докажем, че няма компромис между изключителния дизайн, достъпните цени и устойчивите решения. Стремим се да направим модата достъпна за всички, като поставяме клиентите в центъра на всяко наше решение.

Нашият екип се състои от хиляди отдадени и талантливи професионалисти, обединени от обща култура и ценности. Заедно използваме силата, различията и знанията си, за да изградим бъдещето на модната индустрия, като го направим по-приобщаващо и устойчиво.

​

ЗАЩО ЩЕ ОБИКНЕШ РАБОТАТА СИ ПРИ НАС ​​

В H&M Group се гордеем с това, че сме динамична и приветстваща компания. Предлагаме на нашите служители атрактивни придобивки и множество възможности за професионално развитие по целия свят.

• 25% служителска отстъпка за всички марки от H&M Group, както в магазините, така и онлайн (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories и ARKET);
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Научи повече за програмата ни тук;
• Ваучери за храна на стойност 78€;
• Осигуровки върху реално брутно възнаграждение;
• Допълнително здравно осигуряване;
• Възможност за издаване на Multisport карта на преференциална цена;
• Обучения и възможност за световно кариерно развитие в компанията;
• Програма “Препоръчай приятел” с включен бонус;
• Бонусна система, формираща се от определени условия;
• Платен отпуск при сключване на брак;
• H&M карта-подарък при раждане на бебе;
• Ваучер при навършване на 10 години в компанията;
• Възнаграждение при пенсиониране;

ПРИСЪЕДИНИ СЕ КЪМ НАС

Нашите ценности, приобщаваща и сплотена култура ни различават от всички останали. Но най-важни са хората, които ни правят това, което сме.

Това е постоянна позиция на пълен работен ден, намираща се в град Русе.

Очакваме твоята кандидатура като ни изпратиш актуално CV на английски език. Поради политиката за личните данни, приемаме кандидатури единствено през кариерната ни страница.

Направи следващата крачка в кариерното си развитие с нас. Пътешествието започва тук.

* Стремим се да имаме справедлив и прозрачен процес и затова любезно молим да не прилагаш мотивационно писмо към кандидатурата си, тъй като то често съдържа информация, която лесно би могла да бъде разбрана пристрастно.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Mobile
jobs.description:
At Mudflap, we're modernizing the $1 trillion trucking industry, the backbone of the U.S. economy. By helping over 100,000 underserved small businesses save over $1 billion on fuel, Mudflap has quickly grown into a profitable fintech platform that processes billions in annual payment volume.



As our Senior Mobile Engineering Manager, you'll lead the evolution of mobile engineering at Mudflap. You'll oversee a growing mobile organization while helping define how mobile engineers partner with cross-functional product teams as we evolve toward a product-pod model. Beyond leading teams, you'll shape our long-term mobile architecture, establish engineering best practices, and build the technical foundation for a rapidly expanding suite of products serving the trucking industry.



This role requires exceptional engineering leadership, deep mobile expertise, and a strong point of view on modern software development—including how AI and agentic workflows can improve engineering productivity, quality, and developer experience.



Work Location: We value in-person connection and have offices in both Palo Alto, CA and Austin, TX. While we prefer candidates located in these hubs for occasional meetings and team collaboration, we are open to remote team members who can travel periodically as needed.



Expectations (In this role, you will:)

 - Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing mobile engineering organization of 10+ engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and customer obsession.

 - Drive the delivery of high-quality mobile experiences for consumer fintech and marketplace products, balancing near-term roadmap execution with long-term platform investments.

 - Execute Mudflap's mobile engineering strategy, shaping our architecture, platform direction, and technical standards as the business and product portfolio continue to grow.

 - Own our mobile architecture strategy, making thoughtful decisions across native, cross-platform, and hybrid approaches that balance developer productivity, platform consistency, performance, and customer experience.

 - Lead the evolution of our native iOS and Android applications to React Native, making thoughtful architectural decisions that balance developer productivity, platform consistency, performance, and customer experience.

 - Partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders across backend, infrastructure, and web to define technical vision, organizational structure, roadmap priorities, and strategic investments that enable a cohesive mobile platform.

 - Champion engineering excellence by driving best practices across code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and AI-assisted, agentic software development.
   
   

Experience (What we look for:)

 - 5+ years of engineering management experience leading high-performing mobile engineering teams, ideally with 5–10 direct reports.

 - Strong mobile engineering background with deep experience across native and cross-platform frameworks, along with the ability to evaluate emerging mobile technologies and make the right call for the team's stage.

 - Experience defining and evolving mobile architecture at scale, including evaluating tradeoffs between native and cross-platform approaches.

 - Background building consumer mobile products, ideally in fintech, marketplaces, or other high-growth technology companies.

 - Proven success scaling engineering organizations through periods of technical and organizational change in both startup and larger company environments.

 - Strong technical leadership with a track record of delivering complex products while balancing technical excellence with pragmatic business outcomes.

 - Experience introducing modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development, automation, and agentic workflows that improve developer productivity and software quality.

 - Excellent communication, systems thinking, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence Product, Design, Data, and Engineering leaders.

 - Passion for coaching engineers, building high-performing teams, and advocating for mobile-specific considerations such as performance, offline capabilities, and network efficiency.
   
   

Perks and Benefits (What we offer):

 - Competitive salary and equity in a high-growth startup

 - Multiple health benefit options

 - Responsible Time Off

 - 401(k) matching

 - Opportunities and support for major career growth

 - Annual Company offsite event (Mudfest!)
   
   

The salary range for this role is $240,000 - $270,000. This information reflects a base salary range for this position based on current market data, which may be subject to change as new market data becomes available. The candidate's skills, experience, and other relevant factors will determine the exact compensation.



Company Overview (Who we are):

Mudflap is on a mission to transform the trucking and logistics industry by leveling the playing field for owner operators and small fleets. Backed by top-tier venture investors, including QED, Matrix Partners, Commerce Ventures, NFX, and 500 Startups and included in the Forbes Fintech 50 list, Mudflap offers fleet fuel management solutions. Our core team hails from Disney, Uber, Procore, DoorDash, Google, Meta, Capital One, Affirm and Brex.



Here are the core values that we believe in and look for in new teammates:

 - Be Customer Obsessed: We deeply understand customer needs and put our customers at the center of everything we do

 - Make it Count: Act like an owner by focusing on the impact of your work

 - Find a Way: Be a creative problem solver who pushes past roadblocks to win for our customers and our teammates

 - Sweat the Details: We keep our standards high and achieve them by paying attention to every detail

 - Be Curious: Use a growth mindset to question assumptions, take calculated risks and stretch the boundaries of what’s possible

jobs.title: Head of Expansion at AIOS — Remote, $200-$400k/yr + .15% - 0.5% equity
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $350M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.

We’re faithfully serving >150k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

 1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

 2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

 - Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

 - Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

 - Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

 - Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

 - Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS https://app.notion.com/p/Working-at-AIOS-5b5c0a584af44de78ac7fb9b2cf8d993?pvs=21


BEING HEAD OF EXPANSION AT AIOS

We are building a world-class team.

As Head of Expansion at AIOS, your fundamental role is to rapidly increase the number of global GLP-1 customers that we can serve, starting with blitzscaling across Europe.

Your mandate is to get us launch-ready across every priority European market: all legal, clinical, pharmaceutical and v1 operational infrastructure firmly in place so our Growth team can test and scale new countries quickly.

You’ll swiftly identify which countries we should enter next based on market size, customer demand, regulatory complexity, and speed to launch.

You’ll also:

 - Close any critical legal, clinical, supply and operational gaps in European countries we can already serve.

 - Work out precisely what is preventing us from launching in each priority market we’re not yet live in

 - Carve out the fastest compliant route into each of those markets, whether that means building the required capabilities internally, partnering with established local providers, or acquiring existing infrastructure.

You will not be behind-the-scenes producing market-entry strategy decks. You’ll be hands-on driving every country launch, moving crisply between research, negotiation, diligence, and execution.

Great performance in this role means we can compliantly launch in any attractive European market in weeks rather than years, and we’re serving more than one million patients across Europe by the end of 2028.

If you nail the role, you’ll be a leading candidate for future senior Ops roles (VP, COO).

This is a full-time, mostly remote role with European travel as needed, and you’ll work async in the timezone of your choice — as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time for calls as needed.

This is a senior role. You’ll report directly to me, Richie :) (CEO https://www.linkedin.com/in/richard-cartwright). I’m intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

You’ll also work most closely with:

 - Joey Gracek (Head of Business Operations https://www.linkedin.com/in/josephgracek/)

 - Jordan Pellikan (Chief of Staff https://www.linkedin.com/in/jordan-pellikan-847023201/)

 - Dave Lane (Head of Performance https://www.linkedin.com/in/davidanthonylane/)


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

What are the key responsibilities of this role

 - Expansion: You’ll own European expansion from market research through launch readiness, turning “we should enter this country” into “we can compliantly serve patients here”, then repeat the process faster every time.

 - Prioritisation: You’ll determine which countries we should enter next based on market size, customer demand, unit economics, regulatory complexity and speed to launch.

 - Planning: You’ll identify precisely what is blocking us from launching in each priority country, then construct the plan to plow through blockers.

 - Build or Buy: You’ll choose the fastest compliant route into each market, whether that means architecting internally, partnering with established local providers, and/or acquiring existing infrastructure.

 - Legal & Regulatory: You’ll make sure we have the appropriate legal entities, local/national permissions, registrations, contracts and compliance frameworks required to operate.

 - Clinical: You’ll establish the clinical infrastructure required to serve patients, including helping staff the initial clinical team if building from 0.

 - Supply & Fulfilment: You’ll secure reliable medication supply, pharmacy partner(s), and fulfilment infrastructure so we can launch quickly and scale without operational constraints.

 - Readiness: You’ll coordinate the legal, clinical, product, operational and supply work required for our Growth team to begin testing each market as quickly as possible.

 - Playbook: You’ll turn what we learn from each launch into a repeatable system, reducing the time, cost and complexity required to enter the next country.


NEED TO HAVE

 - Experience: You have 5+ years in expansion, market launch, business operations, general management, or a similarly high-ownership role. I have a strong preference for people who understand & enjoy the scary speed of a high-growth startup.

 - Launches: You have personally owned taking European launches from idea to live operations. You know what it takes and remain close to the metal.

 - Judgement: You determine which markets are actually worth entering, what must be true for them to work, and whether we should build, partner, or acquire.

 - Execution: You smoothly move from strategy-mode into the trenches. You’re comfortable negotiating partnerships, reviewing contracts, setting up entities, solving supply constraints, and doing whatever else is required to compliantly launch.

 - Complexity: You can grok complex regulatory environments and work effectively across legal, clinical, and ops. You use experts to reach decisions where needed, while never outsourcing your ownership.

 - Clockspeed: You learn unfamiliar markets unusually quickly. You know how to find the right people, ask sharp questions, separate real blockers from perceived blockers, and reach high-quality decisions without months of research.

 - Project Management: You run several country launches concurrently without losing control of the details. You create clear plans with DRIs and deadlines.

 - Systems: You turn each launch into reusable scaffolding. You identify what can be standardised across Europe to continuously reduce the time required to launch.

 - Ownership: You truly operate like a founder. You don’t wait for complete information, perfect resources, or somebody else to remove a blocker. You take responsibility for the result until patients are being served.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Regulatory: You’ve operated in a heavily regulated industry and know how to move quickly without treating compliance as somebody else’s problem.

 - European Expansion: You’ve launched and scaled businesses across multiple European countries, namely Germany, the Netherlands, France, Spain, Italy, and/or the Nordics.

 - Evaluation: You have experience evaluating partnerships, joint ventures, licensing arrangements, or acquisitions as routes into new markets. You have conducted diligence, structured a deal, and closed it.

 - AI-Native: You use AI to research markets, analyse regulations, evaluate opportunities, draft plans, automate workflows, and increase the amount you can personally execute.

 - Talent: You’ve built and managed a lean, high-performance team across multiple countries. You detest incompetence in your team.

 - Founder: You’ve founded something (no matter how small), or joined a project early. You may want to start your own company in the future.

 - Figure It Out: You’re one of those timeless people who could be dropped anywhere in the world, in any century, and figure out how to make progress.


OUR CULTURAL STANDARDS

We aim to make this your life’s work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

 1.  Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

 2.  Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can’t look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

 3.  Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you’re choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we’ve already done, however far we’ve already come — it’s still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

 4.  If we’re average we fail: We are only interested in “insanely great”, a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

 5.  Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn’t say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

 6.  A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

 7.  Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

 8.  Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You’ll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

 9.  Keep your head down: We’re boring people doing exciting work. We don’t chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

 10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 “You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take.”

jobs.title: Avionics and Electrical Engineering Fall Co-op
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

• Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

• What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

• It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

YOUR MISSION

As a member of our Avionics & Electrical Engineering CO-OP Program, you will gain hands-on experience contributing to the design, testing, and documentation of mission-critical spacecraft avionics and electrical systems. This role focuses on hardware documentation, board bring-up testing, and electrical system verification. CO-OP responsibilities may include:

• Electrical Engineering Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive electrical engineering documentation including schematics, interface control documents (ICDs), component specifications, test procedures, and design rationale reports for avionics subsystems.

• Board Bring-Up Testing and Verification: Support hardware bring-up activities for avionics flight boards and ground support electronics, including power sequencing verification, signal integrity testing, functional validation, and debugging of prototype PCBAs using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and multimeters.

• Avionics System Integration and Test Support: Assist in the integration and testing of avionics subsystems including flight computers, power distribution units, communication systems, and sensor interfaces. Support functional testing, interface verification, and anomaly resolution during spacecraft integration.

• Electrical Harnessing and Interface Design: Collaborate with electrical and mechanical teams to define wiring harness designs, connector pinouts, and electrical interface specifications for power and data distribution across spacecraft subsystems. Support harness routing analysis and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) considerations.

• Environmental Test Planning and Execution: Develop test procedures and support execution of environmental qualification tests for avionics hardware including thermal vacuum (TVAC), vibration, shock, and electromagnetic interference/compatibility (EMI/EMC) testing. Collect test data, document results, and support post-test analysis and failure investigation.

• PCB Design Review and Analysis: Participate in PCB design reviews for avionics boards, reviewing layout for signal integrity, power integrity, thermal management, and design for manufacturing (DFM). Support component selection, worst-case circuit analysis, and derating analysis to ensure mission reliability.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Collaborate closely with mentors and team members to apply your knowledge and develop technical skills in a fast-paced environment.

• Engage in cross-functional teamwork, interacting with engineers from electrical, mechanical, software, and systems disciplines to solve complex challenges.

• Maintain accurate and professional engineering documentation following industry standards and internal processes.

• Showcase your work through presentations or project reviews.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Currently enrolled in Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline at a four-year accredited university.

• Strong electrical engineering fundamentals including circuit analysis, digital logic, and analog electronics.

• Hands-on experience with electrical test equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, function generators, logic analyzers, or power supplies (laboratory, academic, internship, or personal project experience applicable).

• Experience in the development, testing, or documentation of electrical/electronic systems for aircraft, spacecraft, or similar complex systems (internships, laboratory, academic, and personal/team project experience is applicable).

• Strong technical writing and documentation skills with attention to detail.

• Must be able to work full time, on-site at Denver or Long Beach, CO for 20 consecutive weeks beginning in Sep 2026

• Must be able to provide own transportation and housing.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Have completed their Junior and/or Senior year

• GPA of 3.5 or above

• Coursework or project experience in embedded systems, microcontrollers, or digital design

• Experience with PCB design tools (Altium, OrCAD, KiCAD) or circuit simulation tools (LTspice, PSpice, MATLAB/Simulink)

• Familiarity with communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, RS-422, or SpaceWire

• Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, MATLAB, or C/C++

• Exposure to aerospace or defense electrical standards (MIL-STD-1553, MIL-STD-461, DO-160, etc.)

• Knowledge of power electronics, DC-DC converters, or power distribution architectures

• Understanding of signal integrity, power integrity, and EMI/EMC design principles

• Passionate about advancing space security and sustainability

• Resilient problem-solving attitude

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Denver or Long Beach

• Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.

• Physical demands—the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving

COMPENSATION

• Base Salary: $28-$32/hour

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us.

jobs.title: Independent Territory Sales Representative - Philadelphia, PA
jobs.description:
WHAT IS REPRALLY?



RepRally is an AI-powered online marketplace that connects independent retailers directly with thousands of popular Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) brands. Normally, these stores are forced to buy from giant middleman distributors who charge high prices. We fix that by combining our digital platform with the unstoppable power of real, face-to-face relationships.

While we have an online platform, our independent sales partners are the true face and heartbeat of our network. Tech alone cannot replace a handshake, so we provide the inventory, the digital catalog, and the logistics, while you build the local trust needed to grow your own book of business.




ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for motivated, highly driven independent contractors to take over and grow their own local sales territory in the Philadelphia Metro Area. As a 1099 Independent Sales Representative, you run your own business. You control your schedule, your methods, and your earning potential, backed by our easy-to-use phone app and a catalog of thousands of top-selling items.


Operating Your Territory: You will be targeting independent retailers across the Philadelphia Metro Area—convenience stores, gas stations, bodegas, liquor stores, smoke shops, and any independently owned business that sells CPG goods. If it's independently owned and you can get in touch with the decision-maker, they are a potential client.

 - Independent Outreach: Walking into stores, getting past the counter, and pitching the RepRally platform directly to business owners.

 - Relationship Management: Prospecting new stores, earning the owner's trust, and managing your own client relationships.

 - Driving Volume: Using our mobile app right in the aisle to facilitate initial orders, then actively managing your accounts to secure continuous, high-volume re-orders.
   
   


WHAT WE LOOK FOR


 - Sales or Hustle Experience: Experience in B2B sales, delivery routes, or independent contracting is great—but a refusal to give up is what actually matters.

 - Comfort with Cold Pitching: You do not take "no" personally. You are comfortable walking into a store cold and following up until you close the account.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

jobs.description:
ABOUT HANDSHAKE

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

Why join Handshake now:

 - Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

 - Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions

 - Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

 - Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

About Handshake AI

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of our engineering organization and our most strategic customers, including leading AI labs. You'll contribute to the full lifecycle of high-impact deployments—helping scope technical requirements, building and iterating on solutions that directly improve customer workflows and model performance. You'll operate across the stack in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, working closely with senior engineers to shape how we approach our most critical partnerships.

This is a unique opportunity to combine hands-on technical work with direct customer engagement—learning how to deliver at the highest level while growing your skills in a forward-deployed environment.

Location: San Francisco, CA | 5 days/week in-office

 - Partner with AI labs and cross-functional stakeholders to understand technical challenges, help translate requirements into actionable engineering plans, and contribute to alignment across teams.

 - Build and iterate on tailored, production-grade solutions for complex customer needs, often with guidance from senior engineers and minimal existing playbooks.

 - Participate actively in code reviews and contribute to best practices for forward-deployed work.

 - Contribute to architectural discussions around reliability, scalability, and security, and help implement repeatable deployment patterns.

 - Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on tools in response to real-time feedback, balancing speed of delivery with long-term maintainability.

 - Help create and maintain technical documentation and frameworks that enable the team to scale deployments efficiently.

Desired Capabilities

 - 1-4 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally including some exposure to customer-facing, solutions-oriented, or forward-deployed work.

 - Strong proficiency with ReactJS and TypeScript, with a solid bar for code quality, usability, and accessibility.

 - Good understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), data modeling, and system design fundamentals.

 - Some experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP), deployment pipelines, and production operations.

 - Demonstrated ability to contribute to technical projects in ambiguous environments with shifting requirements.

 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to build trust with both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Eagerness to learn from and collaborate with senior engineers, with growing interest in raising the bar on engineering practices.

Extra Credit

 - Exposure to architecting or delivering systems for LLMs or other AI-powered products in customer-facing environments.

 - Experience contributing to component libraries, design systems, or reusable frameworks.

 - Some experience with performance optimization of full-stack applications.

 - Interest in or early experience with forward-deployed, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or customer facing work.
   
   Perks

Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported—and thrive at work and in life.

🎯 Ownership: Equity in a fast-growing company

💰 Financial Wellness: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching

🍼 Family Support: Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching

jobs.title: Operations Strategy Leader
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Rippling, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 


ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

We're building a brand-new Customer Insights function within Operations Strategy. As an early, foundational hire, you'll help establish a global insights capability that partners with Product, Sales, Marketing, Commercial, Strategy, and Executive leadership to make Airwallex a truly customer-obsessed company.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

As Senior Manager, Operations Strategy, you'll roll up your sleeves to interview customers, run surveys, analyze data, and deliver clear, executive-ready recommendations. You'll help define the insights strategy that serves as the company's source of truth for customer and competitive intelligence. You'll partner with senior stakeholders to answer the company's most important questions and shape product, go-to-market, and investment decisions — while helping lay the foundations for a high-performing insights team.



This role is based in San Francisco, CA.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Design and implement best-in-class user research methodologies, including customer interviews, surveys, and VoC programs.

 - Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to capture the full spectrum of customer experience and competitive dynamics.

 - Lead customer segmentation, persona mapping, and win/loss analysis to understand why customers choose, expand with, or leave Airwallex.

 - Analyze and synthesize customer and market feedback, identifying key trends and actionable insights to inform product and business strategy.

 - Help establish governance, metrics, and repeatable processes for a trusted customer intelligence function.

 - Build and maintain dashboards and reporting tools to monitor key customer experience and competitive metrics.

 - Own executive-ready outputs including regular briefings and quarterly insights reports for leadership.

 - Present findings and recommendations to senior management in a clear, compelling manner.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Commercial, and GTM to ensure customer insights are integrated into product and service improvements.

 - Support the hiring and development of analysts and researchers as the team scales.



Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 8+ years of relevant experience in management consulting

 - Proven expertise in designing and executing research methodologies, including customer interviews, surveys, and data analysis.

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative signals into clear business recommendations.

 - Experience standing up new processes or programs in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

 - Strong stakeholder management skills; comfortable partnering with Product, Sales, Marketing, Ops, and senior leaders.

 - Proficiency with research and analytics tools such as Qualtrics or Typeform, and familiarity with BI platforms like Looker or Databricks.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Experience in fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS

 - Experience managing or mentoring researchers or analysts.

 - Deep familiarity with payments or fintech customer journeys and market dynamics.

 - Track record producing C-suite or investor-facing deliverables such as win/loss reports or market narratives.

 - Familiarity with CRM systems and sentiment mining tools.

 - Knowledge of regulatory issues such as KYC/AML.
   
   
   
   




APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

About the Team

DoorDash Commerce Platform is DoorDash’s first restaurant software-as-a-service business unit – offering a suite of products and services across online ordering, branded mobile apps, loyalty solutions, and more that enable merchants to reach customers through their own first-party channels.

Our newly launched Commerce Platform Merchant Success Operations pod focuses on ensuring merchants have a seamless experience during their onboarding and launch. Our team strives to make their transition from their current tech stack to our DoorDash Commerce Platform products fast, simple, and specialized to their business needs. Plus, this team offers continuing support to our merchants, proactively aiming to create product clarity and help them grow.

Within this pod, the Platform Implementation Manager (PIM) Team was created to help our merchants onboard, implement, and grow their business from day one. The team supports our merchants after they sign up, through their launch, and delivers top-tier service and support.

About the Role

The Platform Implementation Manager is responsible for providing a best-in-class onboarding experience for our small-to-medium-sized (SMB) merchants into our DoorDash Commerce Platform products. PIM is the merchants’ “quarterback”, the person responsible for troubleshooting, coordinating with the various internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring merchants have a smooth transition from their current digital ordering solution to ours.

On a day-to-day basis, this means working closely with the sales and account management teams to get merchants set up for success from day one:

• Hosting onboarding Kickoff Calls and project managing the implementation of Online Ordering, mobile apps, loyalty, and gift card programs for our merchants, coordinating with several internal teams to ensure merchants are using our products.

• Technical troubleshooting of issues (within merchants' websites and our own products).

• Educating our merchants on our products: answering “how to” questions, proactively guiding and educating them through the transition and setup process

• Collecting and registering product and operational feedback from merchants to our team.

You will report to the Supervisor of Platform Onboarding and work within our Commerce Platform organization.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Drive merchant onboarding & implementation with clear, concise communication.

• Deliver strong presentations and handle merchant frustrations with grace and support.

• Train our merchants on DoorDash’s Online Ordering product and functionality.

• Leverage your tech-savviness and curiosity to troubleshoot merchants' technical issues.

• Become a product expert and cross-functional subject matter expert on our products.

• Collaborate and support our sales and account management teams with their merchant implementation challenges.

• Share product and operations feedback with our team on a regular basis to share our team’s trajectory and product offerings.

• Meet our team's high bar of internal and external service and timeline goals.

• Highlight opportunities for leadership to improve team workflows and merchant success.

• Be able to achieve immediate results and adapt to an evolving work environment.

• Look for ways to improve and want to shape the direction of the company.

We’re excited about you because…

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

• 3-5 years of work experience in onboarding, implementation, project management and/or account management

• Able to complete tasks accurately, effectively, and on time with superb attention to detail

• Experience working successfully cross-functionally with individual contributors

• Excellent external and internal customer presentation and communication skills

• Tech-savvy: You are curious and able to dig into technical issues and troubleshoot merchant issues before escalating them to engineering

jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions.

About the role:

We are looking for a Staff Electrical Engineer who will help architect, develop, and refine the electrical systems that bring together state-of-the-art computing hardware, sensing, and power systems.

How you'll make an impact:

 - Define the architecture and select components for a complex embedded electro-mechanical and optical system

 - Work and direct others through detailed design of main logic, interconnect, power, RF and sensing systems around a mobile SOC

 - Integrate sophisticated cameras and imaging electronics

 - Incorporate DFM and other manufacturing considerations on the way to high-quality mass production
