jobs.title: Senior Manager, Adversary Hunting
jobs.description:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.

About the Role:

The Senior Manager of Adversary Hunting will serve as both a technical leader and a people manager for a highly skilled team of Adversary Hunters. This team focuses on finding and tracking OT-focused adversaries wherever they operate; the primary output of their work is WorldView reporting. This is a hands-on technical role with people management responsibilities for the Adversary Hunting bench. You'll report to the Director of Adversary Hunting Operations, and work cross-functionally with Intelligence Operations, Vulnerability Research, Capabilities/Malware Analysis, and other Threat Hunting teams to translate hunting outcomes into prioritized intelligence and detection opportunities. Our ideal candidate will have prior experience tracking OT-focused threat groups and leading or mentoring technical analysts in a fast-paced intelligence production environment.

Responsibilities:

• Lead, mentor and develop the Adversary Hunting team, guiding coverage of OT-focused Threat Groups and Temporary Activity Threads (TATs) and fostering analytical rigor and technical excellence.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for the Adversary Hunting team within Intelligence, aligning team priorities and daily operations with Dragos Intelligence collection requirements and WorldView reporting goals.

• Lead day-to-day hunting operations, implement and refine established methodologies, and optimize team workflows across Synapse and Storm Query Language-based investigative pipelines.

• Partner with Intelligence Operations, Vulnerability Research, and Capabilities/Malware Analysis to translate hunting outcomes into prioritized WorldView content and detection opportunities (IOCs, YARA rules).

• Deliver against and further refine key performance indicators (KPIs) for Adversary Hunting coverage, WorldView report production, and RFI response quality.

• Guide team members in delivering high-quality, timely analytical outputs, including WorldView reports, Year in Review (YIR) content, and customer- or strategic-level deliverables.

• Support recruitment, onboarding, and performance management within the Adversary Hunting team, including the development of junior managers and senior hunters.

• Direct hunting support and triage during surge events (e.g., PIPEDREAM) and incident response engagements.

• Represent the team through internal briefings and external engagements — writing blog posts, speaking at events, and engaging with practitioners through webinars, customer briefings, and social media.

Qualifications:

• At least 5-7 years of experience in threat intelligence, adversary tracking, threat hunting, or detection engineering; at least 2 years mentoring or providing a level of leadership to personnel.

• Demonstrated expertise tracking OT-focused Threat Groups and TATs, hypothesis-driven hunting, and producing WorldView-style intelligence reporting.

• Strong knowledge of attacker TTPs and common frameworks used in threat hunting and adversary tracking (MITRE ATT&CK for ICS, the Diamond Model, ICS Cyber Kill Chain).

• Proficiency with Synapse and Storm Query Language for data modeling, threat hunting, and investigative workflows.

• Familiarity with network telemetry tools (e.g., NetFlow, Censys, Shodan) and file-based analysis platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Joe Sandbox).

• Excellent communication skills, including the ability to translate complex findings into WorldView reporting, YIR content, and executive-level briefings.

• Comfort representing technical work externally — webinars, industry events, and customer briefings — and acting as a spokesperson for the team.

• Experience with industrial control systems security and threat intelligence across critical infrastructure sectors.

• Ability to travel up to 10% (both domestic and international).

Compensation:

• Salary: $205,000

• Competitive Equity Package

• Comprehensive Benefits Plan

jobs.title: Regional Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ABBY CARE: POWERING THE FUTURE OF CARE AT HOME FOR ALL OF AMERICA.


Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve.

We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.

Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.

We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.

Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.




THE ROLE

The Regional Compliance Manager is the day-to-day compliance owner for a cluster of 2–3 states and the embedded compliance partner to the operations leaders running those markets. You'll execute and localize our enterprise compliance program in your states — adapting policies, training, and monitoring to each state's regulatory framework — and serve as the eyes and ears of our compliance leadership in market.

This is a high-ownership individual contributor role. You'll operate with real autonomy in your markets, working under the direction and guidance of the Senior Manager, Home Healthcare Compliance — who sets priorities across regions, serves as your SME and manager, and is the decision-maker on complex or novel compliance questions you escalate. Your cluster will be assigned from our current operating footprint and will evolve as we expand into new states and programs.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own licensure and survey readiness. Lead preparation, on-site execution, and response for state licensure surveys, audits, and inspections in your states — including drafting plans of correction and driving every finding to closure.

 - Localize policies and procedures. Adapt and maintain operational policies and procedures for your states, capture state-specific regulatory variations, help develop the state-specific components of enterprise policies, and keep everything current as rules change.

 - Track the regulatory landscape. Monitor state-level developments in your markets — Medicaid bulletins, agency guidance, licensure rule changes, payor policy updates — translate them into actionable operational changes, and feed them to compliance leadership for enterprise integration.

 - Deliver training that sticks. Bring compliance training to your state operating teams, including onboarding, role-specific content, and refreshers tied to regulatory change, and help build the state-specific content behind it.

 - Monitor and remediate. Execute state-level program monitoring, support enterprise audit activities in your markets, and make sure findings get fixed — with trends flowing back into updated policies and training.

 - Be the partner operations counts on. Serve as the standing compliance partner to state operations leadership and the first call when a compliance issue arises in your states.



Your scope covers every health care delivery program we operate in your states today — Medicaid home health, HCBS waiver programs, and family caregiver services — and will grow to absorb new programs as we do.




THE REQUIREMENTS:

 - 5-10 years of healthcare experience with 3-5 years in healthcare compliance.

 - Working knowledge of state health care regulatory frameworks, including licensure, survey and audit processes, and Medicaid program requirements

 - A track record of operating independently, managing competing priorities across multiple markets, and partnering credibly with operations leadership

 - Willingness and ability to travel to your assigned markets (25–40%)

Preferred:

 - Home health, HCBS, and/or Medicaid program compliance experience

 - Hands-on experience leading or supporting state licensure surveys and plans of correction

 - CHC certification or comparable compliance credential

 - Multi-state compliance experience

 - Diverse healthcare expertise integrating operational excellence, quality outcomes, regulatory compliance and strategic leadership.


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive compensation packages that reflect the value you bring. We reward our team for the impact of their work – full-time employees are eligible for an annual company performance bonus.

 - Comprehensive health coverage that works for you. Choose from high-quality medical dental and vision options, including a $0 deductible PPO and a company-funded HSA, alongside employer-paid life and disability insurance.

 - Generous paid time off. We provide policies that allow you to recharge along with 10 paid company holidays.

 - Financial savings benefits to support your future. We support your financial well-being with HSA contributions, optional FSA and commuter benefits, and full coverage of all 401(k) account fees (employer match not currently offered).

 - Paid parental leave to support your growing family. We provide paid leave, so you can focus on bonding and adjusting to life as your family grows.



We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, consistent with applicable laws. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, satisfactory references, and any required documentation.

 




OUR VALUES

 1. Families First
    Redefining healthcare starts with how we treat the parents and children we serve. We go above and beyond for every family, building strong, lasting relationships. We continually ask ourselves, “Would we want this for our own families?”

 2. Urgency with Precision
    Millions of families are waiting for care, and they cannot wait, therefore this is not your typical 9 to 5 job. We match their urgency with our own, delivering exceptional care without compromise. Here, speed and excellence go hand in hand.

 3. Relentlessly Resourceful
    As an ambitious startup, we adapt quickly and make the most of limited time and resources. We solve challenges with creativity to deliver results without unnecessary complexity.

 4. Purpose with Positivity
    We take our mission seriously while never losing sight of the people behind the work. Respect, kindness, memes, and coffee make us stronger as a team and better for the families we serve.

 5. Driven to Redefine What’s Possible
    We are here to make healthcare better, which means asking hard questions, challenging outdated systems, and finding smarter, more compassionate ways to deliver care.



Automated Decision Tools

Abby Care may use automated decision tools to help match and rank candidate work experience, education and skills found in online profiles, resumes and job applications against job requirements. We believe that these tools help ensure objective, data-based decisions during the hiring process, however, all Abby Care hiring decisions involve final human review and input. If you have questions or would like to request an alternative process, contact talent@abbycare.org.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.

We are looking for an experienced Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineer to join our engineering team. You will support Counterpart Health’s existing technology infrastructure by reviewing and improving processes, developing automation tools to eliminate toil, and troubleshooting issues as they arise. You will collaborate with technical leads across engineering disciplines, as well as data scientists and technology professionals, to develop and maintain a modern, scalable infrastructure platform that supports domestic and international workloads across various compute, storage, and networking needs. We are seeking someone with prior experience deploying and maintaining containerized infrastructure and workloads. Kubernetes competency is highly valued.

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will:

• Build systems for declarative application and infrastructure lifecycle management, including continuous deployment, continuous integration, Kubernetes cluster management, and service/workload inventory.

• Prioritize and troubleshoot infrastructure issues, minimizing downtime and responding to alerts efficiently.

• Contribute to setting the direction of the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, ensuring goals align with Counterpart Health’s company-wide objectives.

• Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture that promotes motivation, innovation, and cross-disciplinary teamwork.

• Streamline and automate infrastructure processes, including delivery pipelines and database changes.

You should get in touch if:

• You have 5+ years of programming experience and are proficient in at least one of the following languages: Python, Go, or Shell Scripting.

• You have in-depth knowledge of containerization technologies and orchestration, such as Docker, Containerd, and Kubernetes, along with experience with CNCF-based technologies like Helm, gRPC, and Prometheus.

• You have experience with public cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure, or AWS.

• You are knowledgeable in networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, UDP, firewalls, routing, DNS, and load balancing.

• You understand key SRE concepts, such as monitoring, performance tuning, and automation.

jobs.title: Director, SEO/GEO
jobs.description:
About Fora

Fora is the modern travel agency, empowering anyone with a passion for travel to build a thriving advisory business. We're modernizing the $100B+ travel agency industry by combining powerful technology, data, and community to enable thousands of entrepreneurs to build on our platform. Our business-in-a-box platform gives travel entrepreneurs everything they need to launch and scale, from cutting-edge tools and personalized training to a vibrant community and exclusive industry partnerships. At the heart of it all is our mission: to help the next generation of travel entrepreneurs turn their love for travel into a fulfilling career, whether full-time or part-time. We believe that everyone, from seasoned professionals to first-time advisors, can build something both profitable and personal.

Founded in 2021 by seasoned entrepreneurs, Fora has grown steadily since, expanding to a team of 200+ full-time employees based in downtown New York City. In 2026, we announced our $60 million Series D investment round, led by Forerunner and Tactile Ventures, with continued participation from existing investors Thrive Capital, Insight Partners, and Heartcore Capital. We've also been recognized as a LinkedIn Top Startup 2024, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies 2025 and 2023, and we were most recently recognized as one of the TIME100 Most Influential Companies 2026.

We're building the first truly unified platform for all travel needs—leveraging the best of human expertise and technology to transform how people plan and book travel.

About the Role

Organic search is already one of Fora’s largest acquisition channels and represents a significant opportunity for future growth. As AI transforms how people discover information, Fora is investing in both traditional SEO and the emerging discipline of generative engine optimization to ensure the company remains visible wherever travelers and future advisors seek trusted guidance.

As the Director, SEO/GEO, you will define and execute Fora’s organic search strategy across both traditional search engines and AI powered discovery platforms. You will build the technical foundation, experimentation framework, and scalable systems that drive sustainable growth while helping shape how Fora appears across the evolving search landscape.

This is a hands on individual contributor role for an experienced technical specialist who enjoys building as much as strategizing. You will partner closely with Content, Product, Engineering, Brand, Analytics, Marketing, Finance, and external partners to develop scalable systems, automate workflows, and rapidly test new approaches as search continues to evolve. While Fora may leverage agency support to accelerate execution, this role will own the long term vision, strategy, and technical direction for SEO and GEO.

Key Responsibilities

• Own Fora’s end to end organic search strategy across technical SEO, site architecture, on page optimization, and content strategy, with goals tied to traffic growth, advisor acquisition, bookings, and broader business performance.

• Lead Fora’s generative engine optimization strategy by ensuring content, destination expertise, and advisor knowledge are structured and surfaced effectively across AI powered discovery platforms, including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and emerging search experiences.

• Partner with Engineering to conduct technical SEO audits and improve crawlability, indexation, structured data, Core Web Vitals, site performance, and overall search health.

• Develop keyword, topic, and entity strategies that reflect how people search today, including conversational, intent driven, and long tail queries.

• Partner with Content to develop content briefs and optimization strategies that perform across both traditional search engines and AI generated answers.

• Design measurement frameworks that track visibility across search engines and AI platforms, building reporting that connects organic performance to advisor growth, bookings, and key business outcomes.

• Build AI agents, scripts, and automated workflows that scale research, technical auditing, content optimization, citation monitoring, and reporting.

• Continuously evaluate emerging search technologies, algorithm changes, and AI platform behaviors, rapidly testing new approaches and translating insights into actionable strategies.

• Manage relationships with SEO and GEO agencies, vendors, and contractors to extend execution where appropriate.

• Partner with Analytics and Finance to measure program performance, forecast impact, evaluate return on investment, and connect SEO investment to core business metrics.

• Collaborate cross functionally to ensure SEO and GEO are embedded into how Fora builds, launches, and optimizes products and content.

Requirements

• Seven or more years of experience leading SEO strategy and driving organic growth for a consumer, marketplace, or technology company.

• Deep technical expertise in SEO, including crawling, indexation, site architecture, structured data, schema markup, and Core Web Vitals.

• Hands on experience writing scripts, building AI agents, or integrating APIs and automation tools to improve SEO workflows and operational efficiency.

• Experience developing strategies for AI powered search, generative engine optimization, answer engine optimization, or large language model visibility.

• Strong proficiency with Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, and AI platforms such as ChatGPT and Claude.

• Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies, experiment with emerging tools, and translate insights into scalable solutions.

• Track record of using data to prioritize roadmaps, measure impact, and drive meaningful business outcomes.

• Experience partnering effectively with Engineering, Product, Content, Brand, Analytics, Marketing, and other cross functional stakeholders.

• Ability to operate independently, identify opportunities proactively, and execute with a high degree of ownership.

Strongly Preferred

• Experience in travel, marketplaces, creator platforms, or other two sided businesses.

• Experience managing external agencies, consultants, or contractors.

• Curiosity about the future of search, AI powered discovery, and the evolving ways travelers research, plan, and book travel.

Compensation

Compensation for this role varies based on experience, with an indicative range of $150k - 210k + equity.

• Unlimited vacation

• Health Insurance (including an option completely covered by Fora HQ)

• Dental & Vision Insurance

• Wellhub Memberships

• 401k plan with company match

• Commuter Benefits

• Stock Options

This role is based in our beautiful New York City office (Tribeca/Fidi) with lots of natural light and great views.

Our Values

We’re forging our own path

Fora has always been about driving change within the industry. We’re not interested in maintaining the status quo.

We’re stronger together

Community is our cornerstone and collective power is our strength. We believe we can all go further when we operate together, using our combined leverage to unlock better opportunities and outcomes for our advisors, partners, and travelers.

We believe in technology

We believe technology is an answer to some of the most fundamental challenges the travel industry faces. We believe advancements in AI, bold investments in our platforms, and a world-class data infrastructure will transform the work of our advisors and our partners, while creating better travel experiences for travelers.

We’re here to serve

We operate in service of our community and believe that when they’re empowered to focus on what they do best, we all win. It’s why we relentlessly advocate for our advisors and prioritize their best interest every step of the way.

We mean business

Fora is equal parts fun, meaningful work and serious travel business. We’re unlocking opportunities for thousands of travel entrepreneurs, delivering a stream of high-quality guests at scale for our partners, and providing a superior travel experience for our travelers. It’s a better equation for the future of our industry.

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Authorization to work in the United States is required for full-time roles based in our New York City office. Fora is unable to sponsor or assist with U.S. work authorization. Roles based outside of the United States are not subject to this requirement.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Fora is committed to an equitable hiring process and an inclusive work environment. BIPOC and traditionally underrepresented candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. We will not discriminate and will take action to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, upgrading, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the bases of race, color, gender, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran's status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Senior Cell Modeling & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Peak Energy

Job Title: Senior Cell Modeling & Analytics Engineer

Location: Broomfield, CO or Burlingame, CA

Department: Cell Engineering

Reports To: Cell Applications Engineering Manager

Position Type: Full-Time

About Peak Energy

Peak Energy is the first American venture to advance globally proven Sodium-Ion battery systems as the storage standard for the new era of renewable energy on a resilient grid.

Sodium-Ion is cheap, readily available and safe, making it the leading contender in a rapidly evolving market.

Our leadership team is powered by decades of expertise in scaling gigawatt-level innovation at world-class companies such as Tesla, Northvolt, Apple, Powin, Enovix, Zipline, Solid Power, and Fluence. We are backed by strategic investment and product partners such as TDK Ventures and Eclipse Ventures.

We are a team of engineers, operators, entrepreneurs, and partners driven by a shared ambition to set the new performance standard for renewable energy and grid resilience.

If you want to define how a new chemistry is tested, validated, and trusted at commercial scale — and to build the lab, fixtures, and methods that make that possible — we encourage you to apply and help us power a more sustainable future.

About the Role - Senior Cell Modeling & Analytics Engineer

Peak Energy is seeking a Senior Cell Modeling & Analytics Engineer to develop the predictive models and data analytics that drive cell design, performance optimization, and life prediction for sodium-ion cells. The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of battery failure mechanisms and applies that expertise across thermal and heat-generation modeling, equivalent circuit modeling, physics-based electrochemical modeling, and 3D battery modeling. In this role you will build models that predict battery life, characterize thermal behavior, and optimize performance, and you will analyze large sets of cell performance data to surface trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities.

The successful candidate combines strong modeling and simulation skills with rigorous data analysis to create models that drive innovation and efficiency across our battery-powered products.

What You'll Do (Responsibilities)

• Develop, validate, and refine battery life models to predict cell life and performance under various operating conditions.

• Develop thermal and heat-generation models at the cell level to characterize temperature distribution, heat rejection, and thermal behavior under operating and abuse conditions, and to inform cell and system thermal design.

• Build and parameterize equivalent circuit models (ECMs) for cell performance prediction, state estimation (SOC/SOH), and integration into system-level and BMS simulations.

• Develop physics-based models (e.g., electrochemical / pseudo-2D / Doyle-Fuller-Newman) to capture the underlying transport, kinetics, and degradation mechanisms that govern cell behavior and guide design decisions.

• Build 3D battery models to simulate spatially resolved electrochemical, thermal, and mechanical behavior across cell geometries and formats.

• Analyze large sets of battery performance data to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities and assess model accuracy.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including cell engineers and ESS engineers, to integrate battery data and models into broader product-level models and enhance battery performance in the ESS product.

• Build and implement algorithms for advanced data analysis, using tools like Python.

• Create and maintain comprehensive reports, visualizations, and dashboards to communicate findings and recommendations.

• Assist in root-cause analysis on battery failures and contribute to improving product design and performance.

• Continuously research advancements in battery technologies, modeling methods, and data science methodologies to improve current processes.

What You'll Bring (Qualifications)

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in battery modeling and battery data analysis.

• Deep understanding of lithium-ion and/or sodium-ion battery technologies, including their failure mechanisms.

• Hands-on experience with cell modeling approaches spanning thermal / heat-generation modeling, equivalent circuit modeling, and physics-based electrochemical modeling.

• Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, with experience in data manipulation, physical modeling, statistical modeling, and machine learning.

• Experience working with large datasets, performing statistical analysis, and using data visualization tools.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to interpret and analyze complex datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

• PhD degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Experience in the simulation of battery materials, electrodes, and cells.

• Knowledge of electrochemical models and battery simulation tools (e.g., COMSOL, GT-AutoLion, PyBaMM, Simulink).

• Experience developing 3D battery models for coupled electrochemical-thermal-mechanical simulation.

• Experience in advanced battery data analysis, such as dQ/dV fitting and EIS modeling.

Peak Energy is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We strongly encourage women, people of color, and individuals from underrepresented groups to apply. We value skills, potential, and perspective over specific credentials. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t look perfect on paper, we still want to hear from you.

Our Core Values

• Speed Through Focus - Move fast but understand why. Focus on the goal, don't sacrifice quality.

• Mission Over Self - It's about the greater good; confident humility. Take ownership and accountability.

• Face the Brutal Truth - Transparency, honesty, big picture curiosity. Fearless decision making.

• Be a Good Person - Kindness, collaboration and teamwork.

Compensation & Benefits

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $175,000, with actual pay varying based on work location, experience, and skills. Our competitive benefits package includes:

• Flexible time off

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Strong 401(k) plan

• Equity opportunities

• Many great work perks

Join us to thrive in a supportive environment while making a meaningful impact in the energy sector!

At Peak Energy Technologies Inc., we believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace makes us a more capable, innovative, and competitive company. We welcome people who represent diversity in their backgrounds, ethnicities, cultures, and experiences. Peak Energy Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, aiming to reach our company’s full potential by cultivating an inclusive workforce. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Director - Pricing
jobs.description:
Title:  Senior Director, Pricing
Location: Washington, DC metro area (hybrid); occasional travel to Heven AeroTech manufacturing and program locations
FLSA: Exempt
Reports To: Chief Growth Officer

About Our Company:
At Heven AeroTech (Heven), we don’t just believe in the power of people—we build our success on it. As a recognized leader in hydrogen-powered drones, we’ve earned recognition for creating a workplace where innovation thrives, collaboration is second nature, and every employee feels valued. Our culture is anchored in trust and a shared commitment to excellence.

We believe great teams are built on individuals who are humble, hungry, and smart—those who put team success first, take initiative to continuously improve, and demonstrate strong interpersonal awareness. At Heven, your voice matters, your ideas are heard, and your contributions make a tangible impact as you grow through hands-on experience and collaboration across the team.

Role Summary:
Heven AeroTech is seeking a Senior Director of Pricing to own pricing strategy and execution across our hardware, software, and services lines. This individual will start as a hands-on, working pricing leader — building models, developing cost volumes, and supporting live pursuits — while simultaneously standing up the processes, tools, and governance that will let the function scale into a full pricing team as the company grows. The role requires significant experience pricing in the federal government market, with commercial pricing experience a strong plus, and demands comfort moving fluidly between BOM-based hardware cost modeling, software/IP pricing, and services labor-based pricing.

Essential Responsibilities:

• Serve as the hands-on, working pricing lead across active pursuits, developing pricing strategies, cost volumes, and Basis of Estimates (BOEs) for hardware, software, and services offerings

• Build out the pricing function from the ground up, including pricing models, templates, review gates, and governance designed to scale as the company and pipeline grow

• Recruit, build, and ultimately lead a pricing team, providing mentorship and training as the function expands beyond a single working leader

• Develop BOM-based hardware and component cost models reflecting manufacturing costs, supply chain sourcing (including NATO-allied and domestic content considerations), and volume/scale assumptions relevant to Heven's platforms

• Develop services pricing models across labor categories and contract types (FFP, T&M, cost-reimbursable), and software/IP pricing approaches appropriate to federal and commercial customers

• Partner with Capture Managers, BD Directors, Program Management, Contracts, and Solutions Architecture to develop compliant, competitive pricing aligned to technical solutions and win strategy

• Ensure pricing compliance with FAR/DFARS cost and pricing regulations, TINA and Certified Cost or Pricing Data requirements, and Cost Accounting Standards (CAS), maintaining audit readiness for DCAA/DCMA reviews

• Support indirect rate structure development, forward pricing rate proposals, and wrap rate maintenance in coordination with Finance and Contracts

• Provide pricing trade-off analysis and executive-level recommendations at Gate reviews and bid/no-bid decisions, balancing competitiveness with margin and cost realism

• Track competitive pricing intelligence and market benchmarks across federal and adjacent commercial hardware, software, and services markets

• Bring commercial pricing disciplines (e.g., value-based or market-based pricing) into federal pursuits where appropriate, particularly for software and recurring services offerings

• Provide accurate, timely pricing status and risk reporting consistent with company-wide BD and Finance operating rhythm

Qualifications & Experience:

Required:

• 12+ years of pricing, cost estimating, or related financial leadership experience within the federal government contracting market (DoW and/or Federal Civilian), with a track record of pricing competitive, awarded pursuits

• Deep working knowledge of FAR/DFARS cost and pricing regulations, TINA/Certified Cost or Pricing Data requirements, and CAS, with demonstrated DCAA/DCMA audit experience

• Demonstrated experience pricing across hardware, software, and services simultaneously, including BOM-based hardware/component cost modeling alongside labor-based services pricing

• Proven ability to build and scale a pricing function, including the processes, tools, and governance that make pricing repeatable and compliant as an organization grows

• Strong financial modeling skills (advanced Excel required) and experience with cost estimating tools, ERP systems, or pricing software

• Demonstrated ability to work as an individual, hands-on contributor while building toward a team leadership role

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field

• Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance

Preferred:

• MBA or equivalent advanced degree

• Commercial pricing experience (e.g., SaaS, hardware, or manufactured products), bringing market- and value-based pricing techniques to complement federal cost-based pricing

• Experience pricing hardware or manufactured components in an aerospace, defense, or advanced manufacturing environment

• Experience pricing under Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs), Commercial Solutions Openings (CSOs), or Commercial Item determinations, in addition to traditional FAR-based cost/price approaches

• Certified Professional Pricing (CPP) or similar pricing/cost estimating certification

• Familiarity with Blue UAS/NDAA compliance considerations and how they affect component sourcing and cost structure

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while building financial models, developing cost volumes, and participating in virtual or in-person meetings.

• Ability to view computer screens and review detailed spreadsheets, cost data, solicitations, and regulatory documents for prolonged periods.

• Ability to operate a computer, keyboard, and standard office equipment for extended periods while performing detailed financial modeling and data entry.

• Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in person, by phone, and virtually, including presenting pricing analysis and recommendations to executives, Gate review boards, and government audit personnel.

• Ability to travel occasionally (up to 10–15%) via air and ground transportation to Heven AeroTech manufacturing and program locations, which may include walking manufacturing floors or other industrial environments.

• Ability to work extended hours during proposal surge periods and maintain accuracy on detail-intensive work under time constraints.

• Ability to occasionally lift and carry materials such as luggage, laptops, or proposal documentation weighing up to 20 pounds.

Benefits Overview:
Heven AeroTech offers a competitive benefits package designed to support the health, financial security, and overall well-being of our employees and their families. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans, paid time off/sick, and additional protections such as critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident coverage, and short- and long-term disability.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:
Heven AeroTech is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.title: Occupational Therapy Assistant
jobs.description:
About Seen Health

At Seen Health, we are revolutionizing the way senior care is delivered through the PACE (Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) model. Backed by top VCs, Seen Health is a culturally-focused, technology-enabled healthcare organization that integrates comprehensive medical care and social support with a high-touch, interdisciplinary approach.

Our mission is to empower seniors to age-in-place with dignity and provide their families peace of mind. We are building upon a proven Home and community based services model to create a culturally-competent and scalable PACE program. We are also building a comprehensive operating system focused on data and workflows that span across systems, processes, people, and care contexts. We want to empower our clinicians and staff with tools that deliver relevant data at the time and site of care and enable them to deliver exceptional care to our participants, which improve clinical outcomes, participant & provider satisfaction, and ultimately our strength as an organization.

We are a mission-driven, multidisciplinary team with deep healthcare, technology, and operations expertise, each inspired by our own personal stories of caring for seniors in our lives. Our name, Seen Health, was chosen to reflect our commitment to provide the highest standard of care to underserved older adults while respecting and incorporating their individual beliefs, heritage, and values, so that they can truly be seen.

About the Role

The Occupational Therapy Assistant will work closely with the Occupational Therapists and the interdisciplinary team to help our seniors maintain and improve their independence, safety, and ability to perform daily activities. They will provide therapeutic interventions, monitor and document participant progress, educate participants and caregivers on adaptive strategies and equipment, support care planning, and collaborate across the care

Responsibilities

• Implement occupational therapy treatment plans under the supervision of a licensed Occupational Therapist.

• Deliver therapeutic interventions that support participants' independence, safety, mobility, cognitive function, and ability to perform activities of daily living (ADLs) and instrumental activities of daily living (IADLs).

• Reinforce therapy recommendations and support participants in developing, maintaining, and restoring functional abilities that promote aging in place and community living.

• Observe participant progress and response to treatment, documenting findings and communicating relevant clinical information to the Occupational Therapist and Interdisciplinary Team (IDT).

• Assist with functional assessments, care planning activities, and identification of participant needs, risks, and opportunities for intervention.

• Educate participants, caregivers, and care team members on therapeutic techniques, adaptive strategies, home safety recommendations, and the appropriate use of adaptive equipment and assistive technology.

• Complete timely and accurate documentation within the electronic medical record (EMR) in accordance with organizational, regulatory, and professional standards.

• Collaborate with the Interdisciplinary Team (IDT) to coordinate participant care, contribute to care plan development, and support positive participant outcomes.

• Participate in team meetings, quality improvement initiatives, and other program activities that advance Seen Health's mission and goals.

• Utilize technology and digital tools to support care coordination, documentation, participant outcomes, and operational excellence.

• Assist with ordering, tracking, and maintaining therapy equipment and treatment areas, respond appropriately to participant incidents or emergencies, and perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

• Associate's degree from an accredited Occupational Therapy Assistant (OTA) program.

• Active, unrestricted Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) license in California.

• CPR and First Aid certification, or ability to obtain within 60 days of hire.

• Experience working with older adults and individuals with complex medical, cognitive, and functional needs.

• Knowledge of occupational therapy interventions, functional assessments, adaptive equipment, assistive technology, and durable medical equipment (DME).

• Proficiency with technology, including electronic health records (EHRs), care management platforms, communication tools (e.g., Slack, Microsoft Teams), and digital documentation systems.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively educate participants, caregivers, and interdisciplinary team members.

• Ability to collaborate effectively within an interdisciplinary care team.

• Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities.

• Bilingual in English and Mandarin or Cantonese.

Preferred Skills

• Experience providing culturally responsive geriatric care.

• Familiarity with AI-powered tools and technology that support clinical workflows, documentation, and operational efficiency.

• Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively balancing changing participant needs, urgent clinical updates, and cross-functional coordination.

• Adaptable and flexible team player with a willingness to support participant care and center operations as needed.

Location

Los Angeles required. Ability to commute to Alhambra required.

Salary & Benefits

• Hourly Rate: $35-$42/hr

• Equity: included as part of founding team package

• Benefits: Seen Health is proud to offer a robust benefits offering for our employees. In addition to traditional healthcare coverage, we also offer additional benefits to help further your wellness and feeling of being part of the team. Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family Life Insurance and Disability Benefits Parental and Caregiver Leave Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized Paid Time Off across holidays, vacation time, personal days, and sick days 401k Plan Personal and professional development, including CME support and career growth opportunities Subscriptions and training on using AI tools including ChatGPT

jobs.title: Applications Engineer
jobs.description:
What we’re building

The marine industry supports recreation, global commerce, and national defense. And yet it runs on technology that hasn't meaningfully changed in fifty years. Until now.

Arc is on a mission to electrify the marine industry. We're rethinking powertrains, software, and vessel designs from first principles. And we're already executing. We started with consumers to develop and harden our core technology. We’re now scaling production of our flagship model with new models and sectors on the horizon. Now we’re extending our platform to commercial applications, starting with tugs, ferries, and defense, with years worth of signed contracts and a pipeline that spans every vessel type on the water.

The technology is proven, the momentum is building, and the opportunity is enormous. The marine industry is going electric and Arc is building the platform that powers it

Who we’re looking for

As Arc’s Applications Engineer you will own the development of early stage technical architectures, costing, and proposals for new commercial projects.

We're looking for someone fired up by the mission and ready to build. You'll thrive here if you move fast, take ownership, and care about the details. Your ultimate goal is to understand our product and market so deeply, and build such powerful internal estimation and sizing tools, that you effectively automate yourself out of the day-to-day work, paving the way for your next stage of growth here.

This is a full-time, on-site role at our Los Angeles headquarters.

What You'll Do

• Partnering with our business development group as the first technical touchpoint, developing concept solutions and architectures for new marine projects.

• Driving the development of internal sizing and estimation tools. You will collaborate with design engineers to build robust calculators for electrical loads, thermal limits, and pricing—with the explicit goal of streamlining our application engineering engine.

• Sizing and specifying complex marine electrical equipment, including 1000V DC busses, multi-MWh energy storage systems, switchgear, and electric propulsion motors.

• Generating high-level CAD layouts to validate space claims for major equipment (e.g., demonstrating switchgear cabinet lineups within a vessel's hull).

• Estimating costs and material take-offs (BOMs), taking full ownership of the final pricing roll-up and project margins.

• Collaborating closely and empathetically with core engineering, supply chain, and our technical writing team to translate your architectures into clear, compliant, and persuasive bid packages.

• Evaluating customer requirements, ship specifications, and general arrangements to develop optimized technical proposals that align with our mission.

• Presenting technical architectures to clients, shipyards, and naval architects, answering technical questions during the bidding phase with transparency and expertise.

Minimum Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience in the marine industry as an application engineer, proposal engineer, design engineer, or similar role.

• Strong understanding of marine electrical architectures, including diesel-electric systems, fully electric propulsion, and high-voltage DC power distribution.

• Functional knowledge of energy storage systems (ESS), switchgear, power electronics, and power management systems.

• Ability to read, interpret, and create electrical single-line diagrams, system block diagrams, and complex spreadsheets.

• Basic proficiency with CAD software (such as NX or SolidWorks) for conceptual layouts and footprint planning.

• Strong commercial mindset with the ability to confidently own pricing models and margin outcomes.

• Clear verbal communication and the ability to collaborate effectively in an inclusive, cross-functional environment.

• Strong time management skills with the ability to juggle multiple project deadlines simultaneously.

• Comfortable pushing at a fast but sustainable pace, respecting both the work and your own well-being.

• Comfortable spending occasional time on boats in the field or at shipyards for vessel walks and client meetings.

• We value engineers who take full ownership, apply first-principles thinking, prioritize technical problems effectively for the most business value, and actively contribute to a positive, inclusive team culture.

• Must be a US Person

Bonus Qualifications

• Firsthand experience working on commercial vessels (tugs, ferries) or defense vessels, particularly those with electric propulsion.

• Deep experience with high-voltage battery systems and their associated safety requirements.

• Familiarity with marine classification society rules and regulatory standards (e.g., ABS, DNV, USCG, IEEE 45).

• Experience conceptualizing or guiding the creation of computational tools (e.g., in Excel, Matlab, or Python) for system sizing.

• Familiarity with fluid/thermal cooling systems, sufficient to understand and utilize internal thermal sizing calculators for power electronics.

• Enthusiasm for boating and the water.

At Arc, we encourage diversity and consider all qualified applicants equally for employment, regardless of background, identity, or status. You’re always welcome to reach out even if you don’t meet many of these qualifications. Passion and aptitude make up for a lot.

What we offer

The base salary for this role is $140,000* annually.

* This salary range reflects a California-based position and may be adjusted based on the candidate's geographic location

Highly competitive equity grants are included with full time offers. As well as semi-annual bonuses tied to your impact, not just your tenure.

Additionally, Arc offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

• Healthcare benefits — 99% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision

• Parental leave — 14 weeks fully paid for birthing and non-birthing parents

• Generous time off — Highly competitive PTO with an opportunity to earn more time with tenure

• Income protection — Life and disability insurance for all employees

• Retirement savings — Traditional and Roth 401(k) access

• Water fund — $500 for you to spend each year to get out on the water, however you choose

• Professional development — $500 annual reimbursement for professional development and a monthly AI stipend

• Safety Support- Annual reimbursement for PPE, ergonomic equipment and anything that ensures we keep our crew safe

• Captain training — Training and access to take Arcboats out with friends and family

• Office perks — Daily lunches, snacks, and good coffee while onsite

• Relocation assistance — Available depending on role eligibility.

Our values

We move with urgency and build with care. We value these five things above all else:

• Ownership over both your work and the company’s success

• Empathy for colleagues and for customers

• Humility in problem solving and collaboration

• Pragmatism for navigating ambiguity quickly and sensibly

• Inclusion of different backgrounds, opinions, cultures, and perspectives.

We want people who share and embody these values. It is vital that our values align - we’d be happy to elaborate on any or all of these during the interview process.

jobs.title: Global VP of Brand Partnerships & Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
What Makes Us Unique
At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024 – but we're just getting started.

The Opportunity:

We're hiring our first Global VP of Brand Partnerships & Enterprise Sales — a role created to land Cloudbeds at the center of the hospitality brand landscape. Conversations with global and regional brands are already underway; your first job is to close them. From there, you'll build the book that defines Cloudbeds' next chapter as a platform of choice for the world's largest hotel brands and enterprise independent groups.
This is a relationship role in a long-cycle market. Brand and franchise sales in hospitality are 12–24 months of trust-building, pilots, and C-suite alignment. You've done this before. You know the people. They take your call.

How You'll Make an Impact:

• Global and regional brand agreements (70% of focus). Wrap up active conversations in progress. Open new ones with the brands we haven't reached yet. Drive pilots with major global brands that convert into enterprise rollouts over a 2-year horizon.C-suite rolodex in hospitality brands. You have active, warm relationships with Chief Development Officers, CIOs, CTOs, and Commercial leaders at major global and regional hotel brands. When you call, they answer.

• Enterprise independent hotel groups and portfolio operators (30% of focus). Direct-sourced deals of $1M+ in booked SaaS ARR. These deals fund the team while the brand book matures.

jobs.title: Capture Lead - Federal
jobs.description:
WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS.

We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer.

Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro.

Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Cognition is building its federal business, and capture is the engine that drives it. We're hiring a Capture Lead to partner directly with Federal leadership and own that engine end to end—from identifying the right pursuits to standing up the systems that make winning repeatable. This is a builder's role: you'll create the capture function, not inherit one.

What you'll do

Capture strategy & planning

 - Partner with Federal sales leadership on quarterly and annual capture planning

 - Partner with GTM, Mission Success, and Engineering on deal structuring, pricing strategy, and negotiation across contract vehicles

 - Track and prioritize contract vehicle strategy (GSA, OTAs, IDIQs, SBIR pathways, prime/sub relationships)

Pursuit & proposal operations

 - Identify and track relevant federal solicitations, from initial RFI through final RFP

 - Build the operational backbone for proposal response: intake, qualification, bid/no-bid decisioning, color team review cadence, and compliance

 - Manage relationships with proposal and capture partners supporting RFI-to-RFP response on Cognition's behalf

 - Build and maintain proposal collateral, and maintain the past performance, capabilities, and pricing libraries that compound across pursuits

GTM systems & performance

 - Define the metrics that matter for a federal GTM motion and build dashboards that surface them

 - Own solicitation response tracking across active pursuits

 - Run the red-team/AAR process on wins and losses; turn lessons learned into repeatable best practices

Cross-functional execution

 - Identify operational bottlenecks and build the systems, processes, and tooling to remove them

What we're looking for

 - 4+ years of experience in federal business operations, capture management, or revenue strategy at a defense tech, federal SaaS, or government services company

 - Deep fluency in federal procurement: contract vehicles, working knowledge of FAR/DFARS, capture lifecycle, and the rhythm of federal sales cycles

 - Strong analytical foundation—you can build the model, run the analysis, and tell the story

 - Track record of working in and building capture programs from scratch in a fast-moving environment

 - Comfort operating without a playbook, and a low ego about doing the work yourself

 - Based in Washington, DC, or willing to relocate

 - Security clearance preferred, or ability to obtain one

What success looks like in the first year

 - A functioning bid/no-bid and proposal process with clear ownership

 - Live pipeline visibility and win/loss reporting leadership actually uses

 - A measurable improvement in win rate or pursuit efficiency


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Cognition is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout the hiring process - please let us know if you need any.

Our Tempo menu includes options that are protein-packed, fiber-rich, calorie and carb conscious, keto-friendly, and dietitian-approved.

• Partner closing with plant teams to establish process expertise and create trusted relationships to drive change.

• Find innovative ways to make data actionable for our production teams - build processes to better collect, store, and visualize operational data in a meaningful and impactful way

• Enable data-driven decision making by reporting on core KPIs and performing ad-hoc analyses

Setting strategic priorities:

• Leverage fulfillment KPIs & reporting to identify and quantify opportunities for process improvement

• Help team to structure project work and deliver clear, data-driven recommendations

• Develop project recommendations through close work with the plant fulfillment leaders to pair opportunity with plant need\

Collaboration with operations technology team:

jobs.title: Director Partnership Sales - LA Galaxy
jobs.description:
Company Information
For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Job Summary

The Director of Partnership Sales works closely with the departments, Vice President and entire AEG Global Partnerships structure/resources to generate and close sponsorship sales for the LA Galaxy & Dignity Health Sports Park in addition to other AEG properties. This position is responsible for seeing a sponsorship sale through completion which includes outbound outreach, developing pitches, negotiating deal points, addressing client concerns, and finding creative solutions to partner assigned properties with brands. The Director of Sponsorship Sales will effectively set sales goals and ensure monthly, quarterly, and annual goals are met by employing various sales techniques, creating and maintaining new business relationships.

The LA Galaxy is a premier MLS soccer club representing the greater Southern California market. As one of MLS’s most successful and historic franchises, the Galaxy are committed to operating a world-class organization that reflects the diversity and global influence of Southern California while delivering exceptional experiences for fans, partners, and the community. The club competes at Dignity Health Sports Park, a 27,000-seat stadium in Carson, CA, and trains at state-of-the-art facilities that support elite performance and player development. Backed by experienced leadership across sports, entertainment, and media, the organization continues to set the standard for excellence on and off the field.

Essential Functions

• Lead high-volume outreach efforts targeting prospective clients to build pipelines, foster relationships, and drive measurable growth. Identify and cultivates brands/marketing executives within targeted accounts who make event marketing and media decisions.

• Create, package, and present marketable sponsorship platforms that maximize revenue opportunities across LA Galaxy and Dignity Health Sports Park

• Work cross-functionally and cross-collaboratively with various internal departments and teams to research, conceptualize, and evaluate innovative partnership opportunities that adhere to industry trends, and drive engagement and value, including branded content, experiential marketing, in-stadium activations, and digital/social platforms.

• Develop compelling sales narratives, decks, and presentation materials that illustrate the benefits of sponsorship assets to potential brand partners.

• Present business updates, new opportunities and industry-driven initiatives to the management team and sales leaders as required.

• Share revenue/profit building ideas and opportunities with other corporate teams and sales leaders and sale teams as required.

• Create sales plans which are scalable for local, regional and national programs.

• Support the development of complex-targeting sponsorship plans to address clients’ strategic objectives and meet the Company’s needs.

• Host prospective clients during all LA Galaxy home games and other AEG events as needed.

Required Qualifications

• BA/BS Degree (4-year)

• 6-8 years related sales experience

• Experience working with professional team- and venue-based sponsorships

• Experience in sponsorship sales in a global role is a plus

• Deep understanding of the advertising industry

• Exemplary problem solving, communication, and presentation skills

• Ability to synergize the efforts of individuals and teams from multiple AEG business units to accomplish the goals of the company

• Expertise in identifying opportunities and developing strategies and negotiating creative solutions

• Proficient with Microsoft Office Products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and ability to learn required business system

• Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics CRM Platform preferred

• Proven track record in building successful partnerships as well as consistently securing investments with FORTUNE 500 organizations

• Must have a high degree of poise and professionalism when interacting with internal and external contacts

• Strong entrepreneurial spirit and creativity

• Deep understanding of the advertising industry

• Ability to synergize the efforts of individuals and teams from multiple AEG business units to accomplish the goals of the company

Pay Scale: $150,000.00 - $170,000.00

Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.

Benefits: Full-time: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.
